faqs.question: Which agriculture or allied programmes are covered at MU Chittorgarh?
faqs.answer: This profile covers B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture; M.Sc. Agriculture (Agronomy). The [courses and fees table](/university/mewar-university-chittorgarh/course-fee) separates the qualifications and published fee periods.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at MU Chittorgarh?
faqs.answer: 10+2 with Agriculture or Science (PCB / PCM) with minimum 50% marks (45% for SC/ST/OBC).

faqs.question: How long is B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at MU Chittorgarh?
faqs.answer: 4 years; study format: Full-time on campus. B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at Mewar University, Chittorgarh is delivered on campus through the Faculty of Agriculture and Veterinary Sciences, combining classroom agronomy, laboratory practicals and field crop rotations.

faqs.question: What fee is documented for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at MU Chittorgarh?
faqs.answer: ₹72,000 / year · 2026-27. Published annual tuition fee for the 2026-27 session; confirm category or JET quota fee schedule before fee payment. Included charges: Published annual academic tuition fee; hostel, examination and caution money are billed separately.

faqs.question: How does admission to MU Chittorgarh work?
faqs.answer: Admission to agriculture programmes at Mewar University, Chittorgarh is conducted through Rajasthan JET / CUET (UG) / MUEE, alongside direct university merit counselling for eligible 10+2 Agriculture/Science candidates. Both Rajasthan JET state counselling seats and university-level seats require verification of Class XII subject combinations (PCB, PCM, PCA or Agriculture) and original academic certificates at reporting. Check Rajasthan JET or University Application Window: Register through the official Mewar University, Chittorgarh admissions portal (https://www.mewaruniversity.org/pages/Agriculture_and_Veterinary_Science.aspx) or select the institution during Rajasthan JET / Pre-PG choice filling. Submit Academic & Entrance Score Details: Provide Class X and XII mark sheets (or B.Sc. Agriculture transcript for PG), JET/CUET/University entrance scorecard and category certificate. Document Verification & Tuition Fee Confirmation: Verify original documents on campus at Chittorgarh and obtain the itemised semester/annual fee receipt including hostel and examination heads.

faqs.question: What is the recorded ICAR scope for MU Chittorgarh?
faqs.answer: Faculty of Agriculture and Veterinary Sciences, Mewar University, Chittorgarh: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture; M.Sc. Agriculture (Agronomy), recorded term 2022-23 to 2026-27 (UGC / State University Act & Rajasthan JET participating faculty; check ICAR NAEAB cohort notice). This entry applies to the named unit and programme.

faqs.question: What practical learning is described at MU Chittorgarh?
faqs.answer: Rural Agricultural Work Experience (RAWE) in adopted villages during the final year. Experiential Learning Programme (ELP) modules in organic inputs, nursery management, Mushroom cultivation and seed production. Field visits to Krishi Vigyan Kendras (KVKs), state agricultural research stations and agri-input processing plants in Rajasthan.

faqs.question: What student facilities are documented for MU Chittorgarh?
faqs.answer: Student Hostels, Library & Transport: Separate boys and girls residential hostels at Chittorgarh, agricultural library journals, mess and city bus connectivity.

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for MU Chittorgarh?
faqs.answer: Mewar University, Chittorgarh offers merit-based tuition scholarships based on Class XII / qualifying examination marks or JET rank, alongside Rajasthan government post-matric scholarships (SJMS / Samaj Kalyan Vibhag) for eligible SC, ST, OBC, MBC and EBC students. University Entrance & Qualifying Marks Merit Scholarship (2026-27): Tuition fee waiver slabs (10% to 50% in first year) for applicants scoring 75%+ to 90%+ in 10+2 or high rank in Rajasthan JET / CUET; continuation requires maintaining minimum SGPA and 75% attendance. Rajasthan State Post-Matric & Girl Child Agriculture Incentive: Eligible Rajasthan domicile students can apply on the Rajasthan SSO Scholarship Portal; girl students in agriculture may also check state Rajshree / Agriculture Department incentive schemes.

faqs.question: What training and outcome evidence is available for MU Chittorgarh?
faqs.answer: The placement and training cell at Mewar University, Chittorgarh coordinates final-year agribusiness agro-industrial attachments, KVK internships and preparation for Rajasthan Agriculture Supervisor, AAO, Pre-PG, ICAR JRF and IBPS AFO competitive examinations. Graduates pursue roles in seed, fertilizer, crop-protection, micro-irrigation, agri-fintech, warehousing and rural banking sectors, as well as M.Sc. Agriculture through Rajasthan Pre-PG and CUET-PG.

faqs.question: What is the B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture fee at Mewar University, Chittorgarh for 2026-27?
faqs.answer: The published annual tuition fee for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at Mewar University, Chittorgarh is INR 72,000 per year. Confirm hostel, examination and registration charges separately.

faqs.question: How can I get admission to B.Sc. Agriculture at Mewar University, Chittorgarh?
faqs.answer: Admission is offered through Rajasthan JET / CUET (UG) / MUEE for candidates who have passed 10+2 with Agriculture, PCB, PCM or PCA.

faqs.question: Where is the agriculture campus of Mewar University, Chittorgarh located?
faqs.answer: The Faculty of Agriculture and Veterinary Sciences is located at NH-48, Gangrar, Chittorgarh, Rajasthan 312901, India.

paragraphs: Pacific University, Udaipur operates its dedicated College of Agriculture (Faculty of Agricultural Sciences) at Udaipur, Rajasthan, offering B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture, M.Sc. Agriculture (Agronomy). The curriculum follows the 5th Deans’ Committee / ICAR credit structure with core courses in agronomy, genetics and plant breeding, soil science, entomology, plant pathology, horticulture, agricultural economics and extension education.

Applicants can enter the four-year B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture programme through Rajasthan JET / Pacific University Entrance Test. Southern Rajasthan instructional farm at Debari (Udaipur) with maize, pulses, protected cultivation polyhouse and soil-plant analysis laboratories. Check Rajasthan JET or University Application Window: Register through the official Pacific University, Udaipur admissions portal (https://www.pacific-university.ac.in/College-of-Agriculture) or select the institution during Rajasthan JET / Pre-PG choice filling. Submit Academic & Entrance Score Details: Provide Class X and XII mark sheets (or B.Sc. Agriculture transcript for PG), JET/CUET/University entrance scorecard and category certificate. faqs.question: What practical learning is described at PAHER Udaipur?

faqs.question: What student facilities are documented for PAHER Udaipur?

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for PAHER Udaipur?

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at MJRPU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: 10+2 in Agriculture or Science (PCB / PCM / PCA) with minimum 48%-50% marks.

faqs.question: How long is B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at MJRPU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: 4 years; study format: Full-time on campus. B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at Mahatma Jyoti Rao Phoole University, Jaipur is delivered on campus through the Faculty of Agriculture & Veterinary Science, combining classroom agronomy, laboratory practicals and field crop rotations.

faqs.question: What fee is documented for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at MJRPU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: ₹80,000 / year · 2026-27. Published annual tuition fee for the 2026-27 session; confirm category or JET quota fee schedule before fee payment. Included charges: Published annual academic tuition fee; hostel, examination and caution money are billed separately.

faqs.question: How does admission to MJRPU Jaipur work?
faqs.answer: Admission to agriculture programmes at Mahatma Jyoti Rao Phoole University, Jaipur is conducted through Rajasthan JET / MJRPU Merit Selection, alongside direct university merit counselling for eligible 10+2 Agriculture/Science candidates. Both Rajasthan JET state counselling seats and university-level seats require verification of Class XII subject combinations (PCB, PCM, PCA or Agriculture) and original academic certificates at reporting. Check Rajasthan JET or University Application Window: Register through the official Mahatma Jyoti Rao Phoole University, Jaipur admissions portal (https://mjrpuniversity.ac.in/department/agriculture) or select the institution during Rajasthan JET / Pre-PG choice filling. Submit Academic & Entrance Score Details: Provide Class X and XII mark sheets (or B.Sc. Agriculture transcript for PG), JET/CUET/University entrance scorecard and category certificate. Document Verification & Tuition Fee Confirmation: Verify original documents on campus at Jaipur and obtain the itemised semester/annual fee receipt including hostel and examination heads.

faqs.question: What is the recorded ICAR scope for MJRPU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Faculty of Agriculture & Veterinary Science, Mahatma Jyoti Rao Phoole University, Jaipur: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture; M.Sc. Agriculture (Agronomy); MBA Agribusiness Management, recorded term 2022-23 to 2026-27 (UGC / State University Act & Rajasthan JET participating faculty; check ICAR NAEAB cohort notice). This entry applies to the named unit and programme.

faqs.question: What practical learning is described at MJRPU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Rural Agricultural Work Experience (RAWE) in adopted villages during the final year. Experiential Learning Programme (ELP) modules in organic inputs, nursery management, Mushroom cultivation and seed production. Field visits to Krishi Vigyan Kendras (KVKs), state agricultural research stations and agri-input processing plants in Rajasthan.

faqs.question: What student facilities are documented for MJRPU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Student Hostels, Library & Transport: Separate boys and girls residential hostels at Jaipur, agricultural library journals, mess and city bus connectivity.

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for MJRPU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Mahatma Jyoti Rao Phoole University, Jaipur offers merit-based tuition scholarships based on Class XII / qualifying examination marks or JET rank, alongside Rajasthan government post-matric scholarships (SJMS / Samaj Kalyan Vibhag) for eligible SC, ST, OBC, MBC and EBC students. University Entrance & Qualifying Marks Merit Scholarship (2026-27): Tuition fee waiver slabs (10% to 50% in first year) for applicants scoring 75%+ to 90%+ in 10+2 or high rank in Rajasthan JET / CUET; continuation requires maintaining minimum SGPA and 75% attendance. Rajasthan State Post-Matric & Girl Child Agriculture Incentive: Eligible Rajasthan domicile students can apply on the Rajasthan SSO Scholarship Portal; girl students in agriculture may also check state Rajshree / Agriculture Department incentive schemes.

faqs.question: What training and outcome evidence is available for MJRPU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: The placement and training cell at Mahatma Jyoti Rao Phoole University, Jaipur coordinates final-year agribusiness agro-industrial attachments, KVK internships and preparation for Rajasthan Agriculture Supervisor, AAO, Pre-PG, ICAR JRF and IBPS AFO competitive examinations. Graduates pursue roles in seed, fertilizer, crop-protection, micro-irrigation, agri-fintech, warehousing and rural banking sectors, as well as M.Sc. Agriculture through Rajasthan Pre-PG and CUET-PG.

faqs.question: What is the B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture fee at Mahatma Jyoti Rao Phoole University, Jaipur for 2026-27?
faqs.answer: The published annual tuition fee for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at Mahatma Jyoti Rao Phoole University, Jaipur is INR 80,000 per year. Confirm hostel, examination and registration charges separately.

faqs.question: How can I get admission to B.Sc. Agriculture at Mahatma Jyoti Rao Phoole University, Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Admission is offered through Rajasthan JET / MJRPU Merit Selection for candidates who have passed 10+2 with Agriculture, PCB, PCM or PCA.

faqs.answer: The Faculty of Agriculture & Veterinary Science is located at SP-2 & 3, Kant Kalwar, RIICO Industrial Area, NH-11C, Achrol, Jaipur, Rajasthan 303002, India.

faqs.question: Where is BU Ajmer located?
faqs.answer: Sikar Road, Ajmer, Rajasthan 305004, India

faqs.question: Which agriculture or allied programmes are covered at BU Ajmer?
faqs.answer: This profile covers B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture; B.Tech. Agricultural Engineering; M.Sc. Agriculture (Agronomy). The [courses and fees table](/university/bhagwant-university-ajmer/course-fee) separates the qualifications and published fee periods.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at BU Ajmer?
faqs.answer: 10+2 with Agriculture or PCB / PCM with minimum 45% marks.

faqs.question: How long is B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at BU Ajmer?
faqs.answer: 4 years; study format: Full-time on campus. B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at Bhagwant University, Ajmer is delivered on campus through the Faculty of Agriculture, combining classroom agronomy, laboratory practicals and field crop rotations.

faqs.question: What fee is documented for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at BU Ajmer?
faqs.answer: ₹65,000 / year · 2026-27. Published annual tuition fee for the 2026-27 session; confirm category or JET quota fee schedule before fee payment. Included charges: Published annual academic tuition fee; hostel, examination and caution money are billed separately.

faqs.question: How does admission to BU Ajmer work?
faqs.answer: Admission to agriculture programmes at Bhagwant University, Ajmer is conducted through Rajasthan JET / UJET (University Joint Entrance Test), alongside direct university merit counselling for eligible 10+2 Agriculture/Science candidates. Both Rajasthan JET state counselling seats and university-level seats require verification of Class XII subject combinations (PCB, PCM, PCA or Agriculture) and original academic certificates at reporting. Check Rajasthan JET or University Application Window: Register through the official Bhagwant University, Ajmer admissions portal (https://bhagwantuniversity.ac.in/agriculture/) or select the institution during Rajasthan JET / Pre-PG choice filling. Submit Academic & Entrance Score Details: Provide Class X and XII mark sheets (or B.Sc. Agriculture transcript for PG), JET/CUET/University entrance scorecard and category certificate. Document Verification & Tuition Fee Confirmation: Verify original documents on campus at Ajmer and obtain the itemised semester/annual fee receipt including hostel and examination heads.

faqs.question: What is the recorded ICAR scope for BU Ajmer?
faqs.answer: Faculty of Agriculture, Bhagwant University, Ajmer: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture; B.Tech. Agricultural Engineering; M.Sc. Agriculture (Agronomy), recorded term 2022-23 to 2026-27 (UGC / State University Act & Rajasthan JET participating faculty; check ICAR NAEAB cohort notice). This entry applies to the named unit and programme.

faqs.question: What practical learning is described at BU Ajmer?
faqs.answer: Rural Agricultural Work Experience (RAWE) in adopted villages during the final year. Experiential Learning Programme (ELP) modules in organic inputs, nursery management, Mushroom cultivation and seed production. Field visits to Krishi Vigyan Kendras (KVKs), state agricultural research stations and agri-input processing plants in Rajasthan.

faqs.question: What student facilities are documented for BU Ajmer?
faqs.answer: Student Hostels, Library & Transport: Separate boys and girls residential hostels at Ajmer, agricultural library journals, mess and city bus connectivity.

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for BU Ajmer?
faqs.answer: Bhagwant University, Ajmer offers merit-based tuition scholarships based on Class XII / qualifying examination marks or JET rank, alongside Rajasthan government post-matric scholarships (SJMS / Samaj Kalyan Vibhag) for eligible SC, ST, OBC, MBC and EBC students. University Entrance & Qualifying Marks Merit Scholarship (2026-27): Tuition fee waiver slabs (10% to 50% in first year) for applicants scoring 75%+ to 90%+ in 10+2 or high rank in Rajasthan JET / CUET; continuation requires maintaining minimum SGPA and 75% attendance. Rajasthan State Post-Matric & Girl Child Agriculture Incentive: Eligible Rajasthan domicile students can apply on the Rajasthan SSO Scholarship Portal; girl students in agriculture may also check state Rajshree / Agriculture Department incentive schemes.

faqs.question: What training and outcome evidence is available for BU Ajmer?
faqs.answer: The placement and training cell at Bhagwant University, Ajmer coordinates final-year agribusiness agro-industrial attachments, KVK internships and preparation for Rajasthan Agriculture Supervisor, AAO, Pre-PG, ICAR JRF and IBPS AFO competitive examinations. Graduates pursue roles in seed, fertilizer, crop-protection, micro-irrigation, agri-fintech, warehousing and rural banking sectors, as well as M.Sc. Agriculture through Rajasthan Pre-PG and CUET-PG.

faqs.question: What is the B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture fee at Bhagwant University, Ajmer for 2026-27?
faqs.answer: The published annual tuition fee for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at Bhagwant University, Ajmer is INR 65,000 per year. Confirm hostel, examination and registration charges separately.

faqs.question: How can I get admission to B.Sc. Agriculture at Bhagwant University, Ajmer?
faqs.answer: Admission is offered through Rajasthan JET / UJET (University Joint Entrance Test) for candidates who have passed 10+2 with Agriculture, PCB, PCM or PCA.

faqs.question: Where is the agriculture campus of Bhagwant University, Ajmer located?
faqs.answer: The Faculty of Agriculture is located at Sikar Road, Ajmer, Rajasthan 305004, India.

sections.heading: Agricultural education at Nirwan University, Jaipur (School of Agricultural Sciences)
paragraphs: Nirwan University, Jaipur operates its dedicated School of Agricultural Sciences at Jaipur, Rajasthan, offering B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture, M.Sc. Agriculture (Agronomy). The curriculum follows the 5th Deans’ Committee / ICAR credit structure with core courses in agronomy, genetics and plant breeding, soil science, entomology, plant pathology, horticulture, agricultural economics and extension education.

Applicants can enter the four-year B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture programme through Rajasthan JET / Nirwan University Entrance & Merit. Bassi (Agra Road) rural agricultural belt campus with field plots near Khori, horticulture nursery, seed production unit and departmental subject labs. Candidates comparing private agriculture universities in Rajasthan should verify both state JET counselling seat matrices and cohort-specific statutory accreditation terms before locking their choice.

Agriculture (Agronomy). The curriculum follows the 5th Deans’ Committee / ICAR credit structure with core courses in agronomy, genetics and plant breeding, soil science, entomology, plant pathology, horticulture, agricultural economics and extension education.

Applicants can enter the four-year B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture programme through Rajasthan JET / JNEE (Women University Entrance). Dedicated women-only residential campus on the Mahla-Jobner agricultural corridor with organic crop demonstration units, food processing lab, hydroponics unit and RAWE training. faqs.question: How does admission to Amity Jaipur work?
faqs.answer: Admission to agriculture programmes at Amity University Rajasthan, Jaipur is conducted through CUET (UG) / Amity Application & Personal Interview, alongside direct university merit counselling for eligible 10+2 Agriculture/Science candidates. Both Rajasthan JET state counselling seats and university-level seats require verification of Class XII subject combinations (PCB, PCM, PCA or Agriculture) and original academic certificates at reporting. Check Rajasthan JET or University Application Window: Register through the official Amity University Rajasthan, Jaipur admissions portal (https://www.amity.edu/jaipur/uga-agriculture-courses) or select the institution during Rajasthan JET / Pre-PG choice filling. Submit Academic & Entrance Score Details: Provide Class X and XII mark sheets (or B.Sc. Agriculture transcript for PG), JET/CUET/University entrance scorecard and category certificate. Document Verification & Tuition Fee Confirmation: Verify original documents on campus at Jaipur and obtain the itemised semester/annual fee receipt including hostel and examination heads.

faqs.question: What student facilities are documented for Amity Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Student Hostels, Library & Transport: Separate boys and girls residential hostels at Jaipur, agricultural library journals, mess and city bus connectivity.

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for Amity Jaipur?

University Entrance & Qualifying Marks Merit Scholarship (2026-27): Tuition fee waiver slabs (10% to 50% in first year) for applicants scoring 75%+ to 90%+ in 10+2 or high rank in Rajasthan JET / CUET; continuation requires maintaining minimum SGPA and 75% attendance. faqs.question: What training and outcome evidence is available for Amity Jaipur?

sections.heading: Agricultural education at Lords University, Alwar (Faculty of Agriculture)

Field visits to Krishi Vigyan Kendras (KVKs), state agricultural research stations and agri-input processing plants in Rajasthan.

faqs.question: What student facilities are documented for MU Sirohi?

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for MU Sirohi?

Rajasthan State Post-Matric & Girl Child Agriculture Incentive: Eligible Rajasthan domicile students can apply on the Rajasthan SSO Scholarship Portal; girl students in agriculture may also check state Rajshree / Agriculture Department incentive schemes.

faqs.question: What training and outcome evidence is available for MU Sirohi?

Graduates pursue roles in seed, fertilizer, crop-protection, micro-irrigation, agri-fintech, warehousing and rural banking sectors, as well as M.Sc. Agriculture through Rajasthan Pre-PG and CUET-PG.

faqs.question: What is the B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture fee at Madhav University, Sirohi for 2026-27?

sections.heading: Agricultural education at Sunrise University, Alwar (School of Agriculture)
paragraphs: Sunrise University, Alwar operates its dedicated School of Agriculture at Alwar, Rajasthan, offering B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture, M.Sc. Agriculture (Agronomy). The curriculum follows the 5th Deans’ Committee / ICAR credit structure with core courses in agronomy, genetics and plant breeding, soil science, entomology, plant pathology, horticulture, agricultural economics and extension education.

Applicants can enter the four-year B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture programme through Rajasthan JET / University Merit Admission. Ramgarh (Alwar) rural instructional farm with field plots for mustard, wheat, bajra and vegetable crops alongside basic soil and seed testing laboratories. faqs.question: How does admission to SRU Alwar work?
faqs.answer: Admission to agriculture programmes at Sunrise University, Alwar is conducted through Rajasthan JET / University Merit Admission, alongside direct university merit counselling for eligible 10+2 Agriculture/Science candidates. Both Rajasthan JET state counselling seats and university-level seats require verification of Class XII subject combinations (PCB, PCM, PCA or Agriculture) and original academic certificates at reporting. Check Rajasthan JET or University Application Window: Register through the official Sunrise University, Alwar admissions portal (https://www.sunriseuniversity.in/schools/school-of-agriculture) or select the institution during Rajasthan JET / Pre-PG choice filling. Submit Academic & Entrance Score Details: Provide Class X and XII mark sheets (or B.Sc. Agriculture transcript for PG), JET/CUET/University entrance scorecard and category certificate. Document Verification & Tuition Fee Confirmation: Verify original documents on campus at Alwar and obtain the itemised semester/annual fee receipt including hostel and examination heads.

faqs.answer: Rural Agricultural Work Experience (RAWE) in adopted villages during the final year. Field visits to Krishi Vigyan Kendras (KVKs), state agricultural research stations and agri-input processing plants in Rajasthan.

faqs.question: What student facilities are documented for SRU Alwar?

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for SRU Alwar?

sections.heading: Agricultural education at Shridhar University, Pilani (Department of Agriculture)
paragraphs: Shridhar University, Pilani operates its dedicated Department of Agriculture at Pilani, Rajasthan, offering B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture, M.Sc. Agriculture (Agronomy). The curriculum follows the 5th Deans’ Committee / ICAR credit structure with core courses in agronomy, genetics and plant breeding, soil science, entomology, plant pathology, horticulture, agricultural economics and extension education.

Applicants can enter the four-year B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture programme through Rajasthan JET / Shridhar University Merit. Shekhawati arid-zone instructional farm on Pilani-Chirawa Road focusing on dryland farming, pearl millet, gram, mustard and drip-irrigated horticulture. Candidates comparing private agriculture universities in Rajasthan should verify both state JET counselling seat matrices and cohort-specific statutory accreditation terms before locking their choice.

faqs.question: How does admission to APAC work?
faqs.answer: Adhiparasakthi Agricultural College describes an application review followed by counselling or document verification. Its B.Sc. Agriculture page requires the relevant higher-secondary science or vocational agriculture background, while the applicable TNAU rules determine the final qualifying threshold and seat route. These steps describe the TNAU counselling channel. Any separate college-management route must be checked independently. Check the programme and applicable route: Confirm the TNAU entry rules for B.Sc. Agriculture and the seat category before using the college form. Submit the college application: The college accepts its prescribed application with the relevant supporting documents, online or at the admission office. Complete counselling and verification: Shortlisted applicants follow counselling/document-verification instructions; a form submission is not an admission guarantee. Confirm a verified offer: Pay the applicable charges and complete registration only after checking the written seat offer and current fee statement.

faqs.question: How does admission to APAC work?
faqs.answer: Adhiparasakthi Agricultural College describes an application review followed by counselling or document verification. Its B.Sc. Agriculture page requires the relevant higher-secondary science or vocational agriculture background, while the applicable TNAU rules determine the final qualifying threshold and seat route. These steps describe the TNAU counselling channel. Any separate college-management route must be checked independently. Check the programme and applicable route: Confirm the TNAU entry rules for B.Sc. Agriculture and the seat category before using the college form. Submit the college application: The college accepts its prescribed application with the relevant supporting documents, online or at the admission office. Complete counselling and verification: Shortlisted applicants follow counselling/document-verification instructions; a form submission is not an admission guarantee. Confirm a verified offer: Pay the applicable charges and complete registration only after checking the written seat offer and current fee statement.

faqs.answer: The official website identifies AERI Trust, Adhiyamaan Educational and Research Institutions, as the organisation running the college.

faqs.question: Where is the campus?
faqs.answer: It is at Athimugam on the Shoolagiri–Berigai Road in Krishnagiri district; the college places it about 22 km from Hosur.

faqs.question: Must applicants register with TNAU?
faqs.answer: The published UG page says all candidates should register through the TNAU admission website and obtain ranking. Confirm current instructions before applying.

faqs.question: Is ACAR a university?
faqs.answer: No. The audited record identifies a private college affiliated to Tamil Nadu Agricultural University.

faqs.question: Until when does the audited ICAR term run?
faqs.answer: The agriculture entry is dated 8 February 2024 to 7 February 2029. Its printed intake is not a live seat-availability statement.

faqs.question: What entry qualification is published for ACAR?
faqs.answer: The official college admission page requires the applicable TNAU eligibility norms. Current subject combinations, category thresholds and equivalence rules were not independently verified.

faqs.question: How long is B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at ACAR?
faqs.answer: 4 years.

faqs.question: What residential or welfare facilities does ACAR describe?
faqs.answer: The hostel description lists Wi-Fi, RO drinking water, reading space, newspapers and indoor games. These are published amenities; room allocation and charges are not supplied by that page. ACAR describes first-aid supplies and a vehicle for taking students requiring medical attention to a hospital in Hosur. This is a published support arrangement, not a medical-service availability guarantee.

Sathiyaraj — Associate Professor, Crop Physiology; Head, Crop Management.

faqs.question: Which scholarship or support information is published for ACAR?

faqs.question: Where is JSACAT located?
faqs.answer: The official site places it at Avatti near Tholudhur, in Cuddalore district on the Chennai–Trichy highway corridor.

faqs.question: Who established the college?
faqs.answer: The parent-group page says Sri Venkateswara Educational Trust, Salem, established it in 2015.

faqs.question: Does the website list courses beyond agriculture?
faqs.answer: Yes, it advertises horticulture and selected agriculture postgraduate programmes. This draft’s confirmed ICAR scope remains the B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture row in the audit.

faqs.question: What rural learning does JSACAT describe?
faqs.answer: The official material lists RAWE, fieldwork, experiential learning and village interaction.

faqs.question: Which school subject groups are published?
faqs.answer: The official page lists PCMB, PCB with a listed elective, and Physics/Chemistry/Botany/Zoology. Confirm current TNAU eligibility and category thresholds before applying.

faqs.question: How long is B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at JSACAT?
faqs.answer: 4 years / 8 semesters.

faqs.question: Which named academic staff are listed for JSACAT?
faqs.answer: JSA’s crop-management faculty page names teachers in agronomy, soils, microbiology, environmental science and agricultural engineering. The selected entries retain the role/qualification combinations shown on that page. Ms. S. Dhivya — Assistant Professor, Agronomy — M.Sc.; Dr. Paulraj Suryakala — Assistant Professor, Agronomy — M.Sc.; Ph.D.; Dr. R. Ragunath — Assistant Professor, Soil Science and Agricultural Chemistry — M.Sc.; Ph.D..

faqs.question: Which learning facilities are documented at JSACAT?
faqs.answer: Computer laboratory: The official facility page describes networked computer access. Language laboratory: The laboratory description includes listening and speaking practice with recording and review.

faqs.question: Which university is named as the affiliating institution for JSACAT?
faqs.answer: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University, Coimbatore is the affiliating institution named in this profile.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at JSACAT?
faqs.answer: College page lists Physics/Chemistry with Biology and Mathematics; or Biology with Biochemistry/Biotechnology/Microbiology/Home Science/Computer Science; or Botany and Zoology. Its displayed four-subject thresholds are OC 55%, BC/BCC/BCM 50%, MBC/DNC 45%, and a qualifying-subject pass for SC/ST. Confirm these undated college-page criteria against the intended TNAU intake-year prospectus.

faqs.question: What fee is documented for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at JSACAT?
faqs.answer: A verified numerical fee is not available. A dated official fee schedule with tuition, compulsory charges and residential costs was not verified.

faqs.question: How does admission to JSACAT work?
faqs.answer: JSACAT publishes an academic-stream subject table and category thresholds on its eligibility page. Its banner asks students to register with TNAU and the college. Confirm the current university rules, because the banner year does not prove the eligibility table was revised. These steps describe the TNAU counselling channel. Any separate college-management route must be checked independently. Register with TNAU: Submit a single online application. Set course preferences: Order eligible college and course combinations. Follow counselling: General-quota counselling runs online; special-reservation sessions may be offline.

faqs.question: What is the recorded ICAR scope for JSACAT?
faqs.answer: JSA College of Agriculture and Technology: • B.Sc. (Hons) Agriculture (Intake- 175), recorded term 2024-06-20 to 2029-06-19. This entry applies to the named unit and programme.

faqs.question: What practical learning is described at JSACAT?
faqs.answer: The official site identifies RAWE and experiential learning among its teaching methods. The parent group describes agricultural specialist seminars and village engagement. The published course structure uses an English-medium semester course-credit system.

faqs.question: Which teaching facilities are documented at JSACAT?
faqs.answer: Computer laboratory: The official facility page describes networked computer access. Language laboratory: The laboratory description includes listening and speaking practice with recording and review.

faqs.question: What student facilities are documented for JSACAT?
faqs.answer: JSACAT describes experiential learning and RAWE, while the parent group reports village-based agricultural activities. A separate official laboratory page describes computer access and a language laboratory for listening, speaking, reading and writing practice. Accommodation availability, meal charges and transport arrangements for your entry year still need direct confirmation.

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for JSACAT?
faqs.answer: A current agriculture-specific scholarship schedule for JSACAT was not verified. Request the scheme name, funding authority, category rules, renewal conditions and net payable amount in writing before relying on a concession.

faqs.question: What training and outcome evidence is available for JSACAT?
faqs.answer: JSA’s outcomes page gives named B.Sc. Agriculture alumni examples across employment, enterprise and higher study. It lists roles connected with Central Bank of India, the Indian Postal Department, IFFCO/MC Crop Science and agricultural producer organisations. The list is undated and does not establish an annual placement percentage or salary.

faqs.question: How does admission to PGPCAS work?
faqs.answer: PGPCAS publishes a 65% TNAU single-window and 35% management split. Its 2026–27 page says applicants seeking management seats must first register with TNAU, then contact the college. These instructions need confirmation for a later cycle. Complete TNAU registration: The college states that online submission to TNAU is mandatory for counselling and management channels. Follow the relevant channel: For counselling, allocation follows rank and preferences. For management admission, the page asks registered applicants to contact the college directly.

faqs.question: When did PGPCAS start?
faqs.answer: The official college home page states 2013.

faqs.question: How long is its agriculture degree?
faqs.answer: The college specifies four years and eight semesters, with English as the medium of instruction.

faqs.question: Is TNAU registration needed for management admission?
faqs.answer: The college’s 2026–27 page says it is compulsory for management applicants as well as counselling applicants.

faqs.question: Are the listed June 2026 dates current deadlines?
faqs.answer: They are published dates for the 2026–27 cycle. Because the check occurred in October, they should be read as historical rather than an invitation to apply.

faqs.question: Is the diploma also covered by the audited ICAR row?
faqs.answer: The college offers a diploma, but the audited row explicitly lists B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture. Diploma accreditation is not inferred.

faqs.question: What entry qualification is published for PGPCAS?
faqs.answer: The official college admission page requires the applicable TNAU eligibility norms. Current subject combinations, category thresholds and equivalence rules were not independently verified.

faqs.question: What residential or welfare facilities does PGPCAS describe?
faqs.answer: PGPCAS describes separate accommodation for male and female students, with ventilated rooms and regular maintenance. A current room-allocation and residential fee statement is still needed.

faqs.question: Which named academic staff are listed for PGPCAS?
faqs.answer: PGPCAS lists faculty by department and identifies heads for several subject groups. Selected teaching entries below cover management, improvement, protection, horticulture and social science. Dr. M. Srinivasan — Associate Professor, Agricultural Microbiology; Dr. D. Ravisankar — Associate Professor, Agronomy; Dr. S. Vinithra — Assistant Professor, Plant Breeding and Genetics; Head, Crop Improvement.

faqs.question: Which university is named as the affiliating institution for PGPCAS?
faqs.answer: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University, Coimbatore is the affiliating institution named in this profile.

faqs.question: Where is the official application information for PGPCAS?
faqs.answer: https://pgpagricollege.ac.in/admission/. Read the programme, campus and applicable intake instructions on this official channel.

faqs.question: Which agriculture or allied programmes are covered at PGPCAS?
faqs.answer: This profile covers B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture. The [courses and fees table](/university/pgp-college-of-agricultural-sciences/course-fee) separates the qualifications and published fee periods.

faqs.question: How long is B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at PGPCAS?
faqs.answer: 4 years (8 semesters). The four-year, eight-semester curriculum covers agronomy, plant protection, soil science and agricultural economics. Published practical examples include sowing, seed treatment, nursery work, crop diagnosis and farm machinery.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at PGPCAS?
faqs.answer: The official college admission page requires the applicable TNAU eligibility norms. Current subject combinations, category thresholds and equivalence rules were not independently verified.

faqs.question: What fee is documented for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at PGPCAS?
faqs.answer: A verified numerical fee is not available. A dated official fee schedule with tuition, compulsory charges and residential costs was not verified.

faqs.question: How does admission to PGPCAS work?
faqs.answer: PGPCAS publishes a 65% TNAU single-window and 35% management split. Its 2026–27 page says applicants seeking management seats must first register with TNAU, then contact the college. These instructions need confirmation for a later cycle. Complete TNAU registration: The college states that online submission to TNAU is mandatory for counselling and management channels. Follow the relevant channel: For counselling, allocation follows rank and preferences. For management admission, the page asks registered applicants to contact the college directly.

faqs.question: What is the recorded ICAR scope for PGPCAS?
faqs.answer: PGP College of Agricultural Sciences, Namakkal, Tamil Nadu: • B.Sc. (Hons) Agriculture (Intake- 120), recorded term 2024-06-20 to 2029-06-19. This entry applies to the named unit and programme.

faqs.question: What practical learning is described at PGPCAS?
faqs.answer: The curriculum lists seed treatment, tillage and sowing exercises. Later-semester descriptions include specimen identification, seed-processing practice and machinery demonstrations.

faqs.question: Which teaching facilities are documented at PGPCAS?
faqs.answer: Agricultural field setting: The college describes farmland around its Namakkal campus and additional training land at Paramathi. Separate student hostels: PGPCAS describes separate accommodation for male and female students, with ventilated rooms and regular maintenance. A current room-allocation and residential fee statement is still needed.

faqs.question: What student facilities are documented for PGPCAS?
faqs.answer: Separate student hostels: PGPCAS describes separate accommodation for male and female students, with ventilated rooms and regular maintenance. A current room-allocation and residential fee statement is still needed.

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for PGPCAS?
faqs.answer: The home page describes scholarships and awards and gives a group-wide annual award statement. It does not provide dated agriculture-specific award terms; no amount is represented here as an individual entitlement.

faqs.question: What training and outcome evidence is available for PGPCAS?
faqs.answer: The official programme page lists possible agricultural, research and rural-development careers. The home page links a placement cell, but neither fact establishes a measured agriculture employment rate. Request a recent cohort report before comparing outcomes.

faqs.question: How can I contact PGPCAS about an application?
faqs.answer: Published phone: +91 89398 08571. Published email: deanpgpcas@tnau.ac.in. Official admissions: https://pgpagricollege.ac.in/admission/

faqs.question: Which dated admission notices are recorded for PGPCAS?
faqs.answer: Published B.Sc. Agriculture application notification · 2026-05-06 · 2026–27; Published B.Sc. Agriculture application end date · 2026-06-17 · 2026–27. These are the dates of the named events; an earlier deadline does not establish a current opening.

sections.heading: Minimum eligibility and closing rank answer different questions
paragraphs: A qualifying subject or minimum academic threshold determines whether an applicant can be considered under the applicable rules. A closing rank or score describes a particular selection list, counselling round or category. One should not be substituted for the other.

columns: If a number is described as…

paragraphs: TIAC publishes a four-year, eight-semester agriculture course page and category-based entry thresholds. Its online form is an application starting point; the current TNAU selection channel, deadline and itemised fees should be confirmed before submission.

Follow [the admission process for The Indian Agriculture College](/university/the-indian-agriculture-college/admission-process) and the official notice. Seat availability and document verification remain separate from meeting a qualifying threshold.

faqs.question: How does admission to TRIARD work?

faqs.question: Where is NSAC?
faqs.answer: The college lists Gobburu Village, Peddaraveedu Mandal, Prakasam District, and places it eight kilometres from Markapur.

faqs.question: Who established the college?
faqs.answer: Its official about page identifies Sri NS Educational Society and the year 2016.

faqs.question: What farm locations are described?
faqs.answer: The farm page names the main campus and Thokapalli, totalling 74.8 acres in its published inventory.

faqs.question: What career support does NSAC describe?
faqs.answer: It describes vacancy sharing, campus interview invitations, alumni communication and career-guidance activities.

faqs.question: Does the ICAR intake establish current seats?
faqs.answer: No. The audit preserves a printed intake of 72, while other official records differ. Confirm the current sanctioned seat matrix with ANGRAU.

faqs.question: What entry qualification is published for NSAC?
faqs.answer: 2026–27 BiPC route: Intermediate/equivalent with Physical and Biological/Natural Sciences; eligible ANGRAU diploma categories are separately listed.

faqs.question: How long is B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at NSAC?
faqs.answer: 4 years (8 semesters).

faqs.question: What published fee period should I use when comparing NSAC?
faqs.answer: ₹1,26,000 / year · source session 2026-27. Published total annual academic fee for the convenor quota at this ANGRAU-affiliated college. Hostel, transport and mess are excluded. The same table prints a management-quota annual maximum of INR 2,52,000; confirm the actual applicable quota and bill. The revised 30 October 2026 counselling notice repeats this annual convener-quota amount and expressly excludes hostel, transport, mess and other living charges.

faqs.question: What residential or welfare facilities does NSAC describe?
faqs.answer: The dedicated hostel page identifies separate boys’ and girls’ hostels with dining halls, study and sick rooms, recreation rooms and indoor gymnasiums. It also lists solar water heating, camera surveillance, backup generators and RO water. The college assigns hostel/mess coordination, health care, sports and cultural activities, NSS, scholarships and career guidance to its Student Affairs Section. This identifies the office’s remit; it does not establish a particular award or placement outcome.

faqs.question: Which named academic staff are listed for NSAC?
faqs.answer: N.S.Agricultural College supplies a subject-wise teaching directory headed by its Associate Dean. Selected listed staff below span agronomy, crop improvement, protection and horticulture. Dr. R. V. S. K. Reddy — Associate Dean; Mr. D. Janakinadh Varma — Assistant Professor and Head, Agronomy — M.Sc. Agriculture; Dr. Ch. Maheswara Reddy — Assistant Professor, Agronomy — Ph.D..

faqs.question: Which application documents are listed for NSAC?
faqs.answer: All relevant original certificates required by the ANGRAU brochure; For already-joined students, the Associate Dean’s custodian certificate and college fee receipt where applicable. Match these to the official requirements for your chosen programme and quota.

faqs.question: Which dated admission events are recorded for NSAC?
faqs.answer: ANGRAU registered-candidate special-category/AGRICET manual counselling, as applicable — 2026-11-02 — 2026–27; ANGRAU AP EAPCET rank-band manual-counselling sessions; exact individual slot in notice — 2026-11-03 to 2026-11-10 (excluding 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-08) — 2026–27; ANGRAU spot counselling for registered candidates, subject to seats and eligibility — 2026-11-11 — 2026–27. faqs.question: How does admission to NSAC work?
faqs.answer: NSAC says university notifications lead the admission process and describes entrance-based counselling. Its site gives detailed but undated age, category and seat rules; these require the current university prospectus before use. For N.S. Agricultural College, the applicable ANGRAU counselling route now has a revised 30 October 2026 notice: registered candidates follow the stated November rank/category session and check the university’s live seat position. Being called does not guarantee admission. Identify the appropriate entrance route: The college distinguishes Intermediate applicants using EAPCET from agriculture-diploma applicants using AGRICET. Follow the current university notification: Verify eligibility and counselling instructions with ANGRAU, then request the current category-wise sanctioned seat matrix.

faqs.question: What is the recorded ICAR scope for NSAC?
faqs.answer: N.S. Agricultural College, Gobburu (village), Andhra Pradesh: B. Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture (Intake-72), recorded term 2024-02-08 to 2029-02-07. This entry applies to the named unit and programme.

faqs.question: What practical learning is described at NSAC?
faqs.answer: Department-maintained instructional units are described as supporting hands-on exposure. The farm inventory includes agrometeorology and integrated pest-and-disease management. The degree page describes fourth-year RAWEP, experiential learning and an internship with an agriculture-related enterprise.

faqs.question: Which teaching facilities are documented at NSAC?
faqs.answer: Teaching farm: The college identifies farm land at the main campus and Thokapalli. Protected cultivation: A protected-cultivation unit is listed within the farm inventory. Crop cafeterias: Crop, millet and fodder cafeterias appear in the instructional-unit table. Residential learning and mess facilities: The dedicated hostel page identifies separate boys’ and girls’ hostels with dining halls, study and sick rooms, recreation rooms and indoor gymnasiums. It also lists solar water heating, camera surveillance, backup generators and RO water. Student Affairs Section: The college assigns hostel/mess coordination, health care, sports and cultural activities, NSS, scholarships and career guidance to its Student Affairs Section. This identifies the office’s remit; it does not establish a particular award or placement outcome.

faqs.answer: Residential learning and mess facilities: The dedicated hostel page identifies separate boys’ and girls’ hostels with dining halls, study and sick rooms, recreation rooms and indoor gymnasiums. Student Affairs Section: The college assigns hostel/mess coordination, health care, sports and cultural activities, NSS, scholarships and career guidance to its Student Affairs Section. This identifies the office’s remit; it does not establish a particular award or placement outcome.

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for NSAC?
faqs.answer: The admission FAQ states that eligible NSAC students may access the Andhra Pradesh fee-reimbursement scheme subject to prescribed criteria. No current scheme-year conditions, award amount or individual eligibility were verified.

faqs.question: What training and outcome evidence is available for NSAC?
faqs.answer: NSAC describes a placement cell that shares vacancies, invites campus interviews and circulates openings to alumni. The career page also mentions guidance lectures and webinars. These support activities are verified as institutional descriptions; no placement percentage or agriculture salary figure is claimed.

sections.heading: Minimum eligibility and accepted selection route

rows: GADVASU’s NEET-UG-2026 rules require 10+2 or equivalent with Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English and 50% aggregate excluding optional subjects (47.5% for SC/ST, BC and DP categories), plus the relevant NEET cutoff. Category, domicile and quota conditions also apply.
GADVASU’s 2026 rules refer to NEET-UG-2026 eligibility and counselling. Different quota and domicile conditions must be checked in the current official notice.

sections.heading: Minimum eligibility and closing rank answer different questions
paragraphs: A qualifying subject or minimum academic threshold determines whether an applicant can be considered under the applicable rules. A closing rank or score describes a particular selection list, counselling round or category. One should not be substituted for the other.

faqs.question: Does KCVAS offer the agriculture degree covered on other profiles?
faqs.answer: The audited ICAR row explicitly lists B.V.Sc. & A.H. only. No B.Sc. Agriculture accreditation is inferred for KCVAS.

faqs.question: Which university is it affiliated to?
faqs.answer: The college and GADVASU identify affiliation to Guru Angad Dev Veterinary and Animal Sciences University, Ludhiana.

faqs.question: How long is the veterinary programme?
faqs.answer: GADVASU’s undergraduate rules specify 5½ years. This current programme statement is preferred to the college’s older five-year historical description.

faqs.question: Where is the clinical complex?
faqs.answer: The college places it at village Mahal on Ram Tirath Road, about two kilometres from the main campus.

faqs.question: When does the verified ICAR term end?
faqs.answer: The audited term ends on 8 November 2026. A renewal decision after that date must be checked before describing later accreditation.

faqs.question: What tuition does the 2026–27 KCVAS table quote?
faqs.answer: The KCVAS section of the GADVASU 2026–27 prospectus quotes six-monthly tuition of₹1,80,000 for University Quota,₹3,80,000 forManagement Quota and₹4,37,500 forSpecial Management Quota. Other charges, securities and accommodation are separate; this is not an annual or full-degree price.

faqs.question: What entry qualification is published for KCVAS?
faqs.answer: GADVASU’s NEET-UG-2026 rules require 10+2 or equivalent with Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English and 50% aggregate excluding optional subjects (47.5% for SC/ST, BC and DP categories), plus the relevant NEET cutoff. Category, domicile and quota conditions also apply.

faqs.question: Which named academic staff are listed for KCVAS?
faqs.answer: The Veterinary Clinical Complex page provides named staff and roles; these are the public listings checked on 30 October 2026. Dr. P. S. Mavi — Professor, Veterinary Clinical Complex; Dr. Rajvinder Grover — Assistant Professor, Veterinary Clinical Complex.

faqs.question: Which scholarship or support information is published for KCVAS?
faqs.answer: The 2026–27 GADVASU prospectus states that KCVAS students eligible for the Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme and admitted in the SC/ST university-quota category are charged the same fee as eligible GADVASU students. This is a restricted category rule, not a scholarship promise for management, NRI or every veterinary student. Prospectus section 2.2.5.2(iii) limits the rule to eligible SC/ST students under University Quota. Confirm current government eligibility, documents, reimbursement processing and the payable statement for your individual offer.

faqs.question: Which application documents are listed for KCVAS?
faqs.answer: NEET-UG 2026 result/score evidence for the applicable Indian-national admission category; Original academic certificates and relevant quota/category certificates as specified in the 2026–27 prospectus. Match these to the official requirements for your chosen programme and quota.

faqs.question: Which dated admission events are recorded for KCVAS?
faqs.answer: University notice: fourth B.V.Sc. & A.H. counselling — 2026-10-30 — 2026–27. These describe the cited events and do not establish a continuing application window.

faqs.question: Which learning facilities are documented at KCVAS?
faqs.answer: Veterinary Clinical Complex: The official department page describes small- and large-animal clinical services at Mahal. Diagnostic facilities: The complex lists X-ray, ultrasonography and an in-house diagnostic laboratory.

faqs.question: What establishment year is documented for KCVAS?
faqs.answer: Khalsa College of Veterinary and Animal Sciences is recorded as established in 2009.

faqs.question: Which agriculture or allied programmes are covered at KCVAS?
faqs.answer: This profile covers B.V.Sc. & A.H.. The [courses and fees table](/university/khalsa-college-of-veterinary-and-animal-sciences/course-fee) separates the qualifications and published fee periods.

faqs.question: How long is B.V.Sc. & A.H. at KCVAS?
faqs.answer: 5½ years. B.V.Sc. & A.H. is a 5½-year veterinary programme in the GADVASU admission rules. KCVAS combines veterinary study with clinical and animal-management teaching; professional-registration conditions should be checked with the relevant authorities.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for B.V.Sc. & A.H. at KCVAS?
faqs.answer: GADVASU’s NEET-UG-2026 rules require 10+2 or equivalent with Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English and 50% aggregate excluding optional subjects (47.5% for SC/ST, BC and DP categories), plus the relevant NEET cutoff. Category, domicile and quota conditions also apply.

faqs.question: What fee is documented for B.V.Sc. & A.H. at KCVAS?
faqs.answer: ₹1,80,000 / six months · 2026–27. KCVAS table 2.2.5(C), printedp 13: six-monthly tuition is ₹1,80,000 for University Quota, ₹3,80,000 forManagement Quota and ₹4,37,500 forSpecial Management Quota. Other six-monthly charges are ₹31,500. The published entry-time totals include one-time charges/security; hostel/mess and category terms must be read separately. Tuition applies to 4½ years of course work; KCVAS other charges continue during internship. No flat five-year total is inferred. Included charges: University-quota tuition only; other six-monthly charges, one-time fees, securities and accommodation are separate.

faqs.question: What practical learning is described at KCVAS?
faqs.answer: The clinical setting supports veterinary case-based teaching; request current rotation and internship arrangements.

It is located at Mahal, about two kilometres from the main campus according to the college. faqs.question: How does admission to Khalsa College work?
faqs.answer: Khalsa College publishes a dedicated agriculture entrance-registration link alongside its 2026–27 admissions material. Its linked procedure and fee PDFs were image-only in the reading tool. Applicants should request accessible current copies before relying on a cutoff or payable amount. Register in the stated Punjab admission portal: The 2026–27 college document directs applicants to admission.punjab.gov.in and a separate new registration for UG orPG study. Complete academic and personal registration: Enter the requested details, board/university roll number and passing year; follow the document’s instructions if academic data is not retrieved automatically. Log in and submit the registration fee/form: Use the credentials sent to the registered phone/email, then complete the portal form and payment. Follow the agriculture-specific selection notice: The college document labels B.Sc. Agriculture admission as entrance-test/merit based and leaves actual dates to be notified later. Portal registration alone does not guarantee a seat.

faqs.question: How does admission to SSU work?
faqs.answer: SSU’s admission guideline page describes online applications and a non-refundable INR 500 application charge for Indian nationals. Its displayed 2026-27 dates are internally inconsistent, so obtain the applicable selection notice and deadline directly. Apply through the university: The guidelines specify an online application and a separate form for each programme. Read the selection and offer communication: The university describes email notification of selection arrangements and a provisional offer identifying fees and required documents.

faqs.question: Does SSU’s ICAR entry cover all its allied degrees?
faqs.answer: The audited row explicitly lists B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture. Horticulture and agribusiness are verified offerings but are not added to that accreditation scope.

faqs.question: What science subjects did SSU require for agriculture in 2025?
faqs.answer: The NTA listing states PCB or PCM at 10+2 level with at least 50%. Later intake rules need confirmation.

faqs.question: Is there an agribusiness option for non-science students?
faqs.answer: The NTA 2025 listing accepted any 10+2 stream with at least 50%, but SSU’s undated Agribusiness course fact sheet specifies science with PCB/PCM. Because those sources differ, a non-science applicant should obtain the intended intake rule directly.

faqs.question: What practical agricultural units are documented?
faqs.answer: SSU reports farmland, an apiculture unit and mushroom production in its sustainability evidence.

faqs.question: Are the tuition figures on this page current intake fees?
faqs.answer: The programme fact sheets quote INR85,000 for Agriculture, INR68,000 for Horticulture and INR63,000 for Agribusiness per semester, but do not identify an intake year. These are undated official amounts rather than confirmed 2026/2027 prices.

faqs.question: Which agriculture or allied programmes are covered at SSU?
faqs.answer: This profile covers B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture; B.Sc. (Hons.) Horticulture; B.Sc. (Hons.) Agribusiness. The [courses and fees table](/university/sri-sri-university/course-fee) separates the qualifications and published fee periods.

faqs.question: How long is B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at SSU?
faqs.answer: 4 years (8 semesters); study format: Full time. A broad agricultural science degree listed by the university and NTA.

faqs.question: How long is B.Sc. (Hons.) Horticulture at SSU?
faqs.answer: 4 years (8 semesters); study format: Full time. An allied undergraduate option named in university sustainability reporting.

faqs.question: How long is B.Sc. (Hons.) Agribusiness at SSU?
faqs.answer: 4 years (8 semesters); study format: Full time. An agriculture-related business option distinct from the crop-science degree.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at SSU?
faqs.answer: Undated official course fact sheet: 10+2 science with PCB or PCM and at least 50%; confirm the intended intake rule.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for B.Sc. (Hons.) Horticulture at SSU?
faqs.answer: Undated official course fact sheet: 10+2 science with PCB or PCM and at least 50%; confirm the intended intake rule.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agribusiness at SSU?
faqs.answer: The undated official course fact sheet requires 10+2 science with PCB or PCM and at least 50%. This differs from the NTA 2025 listing, which accepted any 10+2 stream with 50%; obtain the intended intake rule.

faqs.question: How does admission to SSU work?
faqs.answer: SSU’s admission guideline page describes online applications and a non-refundable INR 500 application charge for Indian nationals. Its displayed 2026-27 dates are internally inconsistent, so obtain the applicable selection notice and deadline directly. Apply through the university: The guidelines specify an online application and a separate form for each programme. Read the selection and offer communication: The university describes email notification of selection arrangements and a provisional offer identifying fees and required documents.

faqs.question: What is the recorded ICAR scope for SSU?
faqs.answer: Sri Sri University, Cuttack, Odisha: B. Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture (Intake- 60), recorded term 2022-10-11 to 2027-10-10. This entry applies to the named unit and programme.

faqs.question: What practical learning is described at SSU?
faqs.answer: University sustainability evidence describes 40 acres of agricultural land, apiculture and mushroom production. Its report associates farm output with campus kitchens and local food procurement.

faqs.question: Which teaching facilities are documented at SSU?
faqs.answer: University farmland: The 2026 sustainability evidence describes fruits, vegetables and cereals grown on campus. Apiculture and mushroom units: Both units are identified in the university’s campus food-production account.

faqs.question: What student facilities are documented for SSU?
faqs.answer: Hostel and mess support: The finance help page directs hostel and mess questions to officeofdirectoratestudentaffairs@srisriuniversity.edu.in. It describes optional booking subject to capacity; applicants need confirmation of an available room. Student grievance channel: The published student support channel is studentgrievance@srisriuniversity.edu.in. Individual dues and receipts are accessed through the university payment system.

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for SSU?
faqs.answer: SSU’s Scholarship Support Division helps its enrolled students find scholarship information and complete applications. Its published scope covers bona fide students across faculties. The checked page does not establish a dated agriculture-specific award amount or renewal entitlement. Scholarship application support: The division disseminates available scheme information and helps students complete scholarship processes. A support service does not itself guarantee an award.

faqs.answer: A current agriculture-specific placement report was not available in the checked material.

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for Sanskriti University?
faqs.answer: Sanskriti’s undated scholarship policy describes general categories including sports, defence, girls and disability. Its published conditions limit awards to tuition, allow one scheme at a time and require academic continuation without back papers. Agriculture applicants should obtain a dated programme-specific award; engineering and MBA merit tables are not agriculture entitlements. General-category scholarship conditions (undated): The page lists defence, girls, disability and sports categories, with supporting-proof requirements. Only one scheme may apply, tuition-only limits and continuation conditions apply, and the stated exclusions include BAMS, BUMS, B.Sc. Nursing and Ph.D. Agriculture-specific current approval is still required.

faqs.question: When did Karunya’s agriculture school begin?
faqs.answer: The school’s official page states 2017; that is the school date, not the university’s founding year.

faqs.question: Which agricultural programmes are listed?
faqs.answer: The current school page names B.Sc. Agriculture and master’s courses in agronomy, genetics and plant breeding, and fruit sciences.

faqs.question: Are protected-cultivation facilities documented?
faqs.answer: Yes. The school names polyhouses and mist chambers alongside research plots.

faqs.question: Does the checked ICAR entry accredit Karunya’s master’s programmes?
faqs.answer: The audited row prints only B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture. A broader website claim is unresolved and is not adopted here.

faqs.question: Is PCM alone definitely accepted?
faqs.answer: The academics page includes PCM, while the located brochure uses different biology/agriculture wording. Confirm the current intake rule directly.

faqs.question: Which agriculture or allied programmes are covered at KITS?
faqs.answer: This profile covers B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture; M.Sc. (Agriculture) Agronomy; M.Sc. (Agriculture) Genetics and Plant Breeding; M.Sc. (Horticulture) Fruit Sciences. The [courses and fees table](/university/karunya-institute-of-technology-and-sciences/course-fee) separates the qualifications and published fee periods.

faqs.question: How long is B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at KITS?
faqs.answer: 4 years. The school describes crop, soil and plant-health study linked with field practice.

faqs.question: How long is M.Sc. (Agriculture) Agronomy at KITS?
faqs.answer: 2 years. Postgraduate study includes field projects, laboratory analysis and research documentation.

faqs.question: How long is M.Sc. (Agriculture) Genetics and Plant Breeding at KITS?
faqs.answer: 2 years. A specialist crop-improvement degree in the current school programme list.

faqs.question: How long is M.Sc. (Horticulture) Fruit Sciences at KITS?
faqs.answer: 2 years. The school lists a separate fruit-crop postgraduate programme.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at KITS?
faqs.answer: The 2027 UG admissions page states a minimum 60% qualifying-examination requirement for confirmation. Confirm the programme-specific subjects for that intake; older academic pages and brochures list different combinations and thresholds.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for M.Sc. (Agriculture) Agronomy at KITS?
faqs.answer: 2023 brochure: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture with minimum OGPA 6.00/10; reconfirm for intended intake.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for M.Sc. (Agriculture) Genetics and Plant Breeding at KITS?
faqs.answer: The exact intake-year subject and marks rule still needs confirmation through [the official admission route](/university/karunya-institute-of-technology-and-sciences/admission-process).

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for M.Sc. (Horticulture) Fruit Sciences at KITS?
faqs.answer: The exact intake-year subject and marks rule still needs confirmation through [the official admission route](/university/karunya-institute-of-technology-and-sciences/admission-process).

faqs.question: What fee is documented for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at KITS?
faqs.answer: ₹1,46,750 / semester · 2026-27. Tuition for each of eight semesters in the 2026-30 cohort fee sheet; one-time admission fee INR 10,000; examination fees extra. Included charges: Published tuition/course fee; additional charges must be checked separately.

faqs.question: What fee is documented for M.Sc. (Agriculture) Agronomy at KITS?
faqs.answer: ₹60,750 / semester · 2026-27. Each of four semesters costs INR 60,750 tuition. One-time admission INR 5,000 is separate. The schedule explicitly names Agronomy, Genetics and Plant Breeding, and Fruit Science; this is not an NRI tariff. Included charges: Tuition for the 2026–28 Indian-national cohort; exam, professional-development and placement-training charges excluded.

Included charges: Tuition for the 2026–28 Indian-national cohort; exam, professional-development and placement-training charges excluded.

faqs.question: What is the recorded ICAR scope for KITS?
faqs.answer: Karunya Institute of Technology and Sciences (Deemed University), Coimbatore: B. Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture (Intake-180), recorded term 2022-10-11 to 2027-10-10. This entry applies to the named unit and programme.

faqs.question: What practical learning is described at KITS?
faqs.answer: The school describes instructional and research farmland, polyhouses, mist chambers and research plots. Its brochure additionally identifies experiential-learning modules, an agrometeorological observatory and an automatic weather station.

faqs.question: Which teaching facilities are documented at KITS?
faqs.answer: Protected cultivation structures: Polyhouses and mist chambers are named in the school’s facilities account. Agrometeorological facilities: The brochure identifies an observatory and automatic weather station.

faqs.question: What student facilities are documented for KITS?
faqs.answer: The school describes instructional and research farmland, polyhouses, mist chambers and research plots. Its brochure additionally identifies experiential-learning modules, an agrometeorological observatory and an automatic weather station. Accommodation availability, meal charges and transport arrangements for your entry year still need direct confirmation.

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for KITS?
faqs.answer: Karunya’s 2026–27 scholarship page explicitly includes B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture in its Indian-student merit grid. The separate Founder’s Scholarship offers a limited 100% tuition waiver for eligible Indian Christian applicants; its 2026 application and selection dates have passed. B.Sc. Agriculture Indian-student merit grid, 2026–27: The agriculture column lists INR 1,20,000 at 95% PCM/PCB, INR 60,000 at 90%, and INR 40,000 at 85%. These are scholarship amounts, not net tuition payable. Obtain the approved award and applicable continuation terms. Founder’s Scholarship 2026–27: Limited 100% tuition waiver for selected Indian Christian applicants with at least 90% PCM/PCB and annual family income below INR 8 lakh. Screening includes documentary verification and interview. The 29 May 2026 deadline is past.

faqs.question: What training and outcome evidence is available for KITS?
faqs.answer: Karunya Institute of Technology and Sciences publishes an Agriculture and Allied Sectors submission for NIRF 2026. Its programme-duration cohorts report the graduating group, students placed, students entering higher studies and the median salary of placed graduates. These historical institutional submissions are not a placement promise or a salary estimate for every student or individual specialisation.

sections.heading: Which admission route applies?
paragraphs: VIT’s 2026 agriculture portal describes registration, application completion, payment and online counselling. Counselling eligibility does not guarantee a seat; allocation depends on rank and availability.

sections.heading: Official channels and public contact details
paragraphs: Use the official channel for the exact programme and quota. Institution contacts below are public source details; ask the office to confirm the intended intake before applying.

sections.heading: Programme-wise eligibility and selection
paragraphs: The following requirements belong to the named programme. A university-wide entrance or eligibility statement should not be transferred to every degree.

rows: 2026-27: Resident Indian; born on/after 1 July 2006; 60% overall and 60% in PCB, with published 10% relaxation for specified categories/regions; English required.
2026-27 portal: no entrance test; qualifying PCB merit ranking and online counselling.

sections.heading: Application steps for this institution

subsections.heading: Register and complete the application
paragraphs: Use an active email address and Indian mobile number; the portal verifies the mobile number by OTP.

subsections.heading: Pay and upload the photograph
paragraphs: The portal specifies a non-refundable INR 700 application payment and a JPG/JPEG photograph.

subsections.heading: Participate in counselling
paragraphs: Shortlisted applicants attend online counselling based on the qualifying-examination rank list.

subsections.heading: Enter fee-category preferences during online counselling
paragraphs: The 2026–27 portal asks shortlisted applicants to enter preferred fee categories and review their choices. It states that allotment is rank-based; individual results require the applicant’s own login.

bullets: 2026-27 academic requirements are 60% overall and 60% aggregate in Physics, Chemistry and Biology.
A published 10% relaxation applies to SC/ST applicants and specified regions; supporting certificates are required.
Resident Indian nationality and the published birth-date condition apply.

sections.heading: Documents and dated notices
paragraphs: The source lists the following documents. Check originals, acceptable formats and any quota-specific certificates against the current notice.
bullets: Birth certificate or passport copy as age proof.
Class XII hall ticket.
Class XII mark statements for all attempts.
SC/ST community certificate where applicable.
Nativity certificate for the specified North-Eastern states or Jammu and Kashmir/Ladakh categories.
JPG/JPEG photograph of20–300kB and scanned signature of5–150kB, following the portal dimensions.

subsections.heading: Current application dates
paragraphs: No current opening or closing date is quoted here without a verified dated notice. Follow the official admission link for the intended session.

faqs.question: How does admission to VIT work?
faqs.answer: VIT’s 2026 agriculture portal describes registration, application completion, payment and online counselling. Counselling eligibility does not guarantee a seat; allocation depends on rank and availability. Register and complete the application: Use an active email address and Indian mobile number; the portal verifies the mobile number by OTP. Pay and upload the photograph: The portal specifies a non-refundable INR 700 application payment and a JPG/JPEG photograph. Participate in counselling: Shortlisted applicants attend online counselling based on the qualifying-examination rank list. Enter fee-category preferences during online counselling: The 2026–27 portal asks shortlisted applicants to enter preferred fee categories and review their choices. It states that allotment is rank-based; individual results require the applicant’s own login.

faqs.question: How does admission to VIT work?
faqs.answer: VIT’s 2026 agriculture portal describes registration, application completion, payment and online counselling. Counselling eligibility does not guarantee a seat; allocation depends on rank and availability. Register and complete the application: Use an active email address and Indian mobile number; the portal verifies the mobile number by OTP. Pay and upload the photograph: The portal specifies a non-refundable INR 700 application payment and a JPG/JPEG photograph. Participate in counselling: Shortlisted applicants attend online counselling based on the qualifying-examination rank list. Enter fee-category preferences during online counselling: The 2026–27 portal asks shortlisted applicants to enter preferred fee categories and review their choices. It states that allotment is rank-based; individual results require the applicant’s own login.

sections.heading: Minimum eligibility and closing rank answer different questions
paragraphs: A qualifying subject or minimum academic threshold determines whether an applicant can be considered under the applicable rules. A closing rank or score describes a particular selection list, counselling round or category. One should not be substituted for the other.

faqs.question: Is B.Sc. Agriculture the ICAR-accredited course in this checked SRMIST row?
faqs.answer: The row explicitly prints B.Sc. (Hons.) Horticulture, not Agriculture. Broader accreditation requires separate regulator evidence.

faqs.question: Does SRMIST also offer B.Sc. Agriculture?
faqs.answer: Yes. Official college materials identify a four-year agriculture degree introduced in 2019-20.

faqs.question: Where is the agricultural college campus?
faqs.answer: Recent official materials locate it at Baburayanpettai near Acharapakkam in Chengalpattu district.

faqs.question: When did horticulture teaching begin?
faqs.answer: The official 2026 workshop brochure states 2018-19.

faqs.question: Is the old application fee a current quotation?
faqs.answer: No. The form specifying INR 1,200 is explicitly labelled 2024. Current fee and selection details must be confirmed.

faqs.question: Which agriculture or allied programmes are covered at SRMIST?
faqs.answer: This profile covers B.Sc. (Hons.) Horticulture; B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture. The [courses and fees table](/university/srm-institute-of-science-and-technology/course-fee) separates the qualifications and published fee periods.

faqs.question: How long is B.Sc. (Hons.) Horticulture at SRMIST?
faqs.answer: 4 years. A separate horticultural science degree, introduced in 2018-19 and explicitly printed in the ICAR row.

faqs.question: How long is B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at SRMIST?
faqs.answer: 4 years. A broader agricultural science degree introduced in 2019-20. Its availability does not extend the checked horticulture accreditation row.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for B.Sc. (Hons.) Horticulture at SRMIST?
faqs.answer: 2026 agriculture application page: recognised 10+2 with at least 50% aggregate. Accepted academic groups are Physics-Chemistry with Biology and/or Mathematics, Botany-Zoology, Forestry, Biology-Agriculture or Agriculture; the vocational route is Biology with Agricultural Practices, including theory and practicals.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at SRMIST?
faqs.answer: 2026 page: 10+2 with one of seven published science/agriculture combinations, or the specified vocational stream, and 50% aggregate.
