faqs.question: How does admission to CPU Kota work?
faqs.answer: Admission to agriculture programmes at Career Point University, Kota is conducted through Rajasthan JET / CUET / CPU Merit Counselling, alongside direct university merit counselling for eligible 10+2 Agriculture/Science candidates. Both Rajasthan JET state counselling seats and university-level seats require verification of Class XII subject combinations (PCB, PCM, PCA or Agriculture) and original academic certificates at reporting. Check Rajasthan JET or University Application Window: Register through the official Career Point University, Kota admissions portal (https://cpur.in/schools/school-of-agricultural-sciences/) or select the institution during Rajasthan JET / Pre-PG choice filling. Submit Academic & Entrance Score Details: Provide Class X and XII mark sheets (or B.Sc. Agriculture transcript for PG), JET/CUET/University entrance scorecard and category certificate. Document Verification & Tuition Fee Confirmation: Verify original documents on campus at Kota and obtain the itemised semester/annual fee receipt including hostel and examination heads.

faqs.question: What practical learning is described at CPU Kota?
faqs.answer: Rural Agricultural Work Experience (RAWE) in adopted villages during the final year. Experiential Learning Programme (ELP) modules in organic inputs, nursery management, Mushroom cultivation and seed production. Field visits to Krishi Vigyan Kendras (KVKs), state agricultural research stations and agri-input processing plants in Rajasthan.

faqs.question: Which teaching facilities are documented at CPU Kota?
faqs.answer: Agronomy & Instructional Crop Farm: Field demonstration plots at Kota for kharif and rabi crop trials, seed bed preparation, weed management and micro-irrigation exercises. Soil Science & Agricultural Chemistry Lab: Equipped for soil pH, electrical conductivity, organic carbon, macronutrient (N-P-K) and micronutrient testing. Horticulture, Polyhouse & Orchard Unit: Protected cultivation polyhouse/shade-net house, fruit orchard nursery and post-harvest handling practical space. Plant Pathology, Entomology & Genetics Labs: Compound and stereo microscopy, insect rearing cages, disease specimen collection and seed purity testing equipment. Student Hostels, Library & Transport: Separate boys and girls residential hostels at Kota, agricultural library journals, mess and city bus connectivity.

faqs.question: What student facilities are documented for CPU Kota?

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for CPU Kota?

University Entrance & Qualifying Marks Merit Scholarship (2026-27): Tuition fee waiver slabs (10% to 50% in first year) for applicants scoring 75%+ to 90%+ in 10+2 or high rank in Rajasthan JET / CUET; continuation requires maintaining minimum SGPA and 75% attendance. faqs.question: What training and outcome evidence is available for CPU Kota?
faqs.answer: The placement and training cell at Career Point University, Kota coordinates final-year agribusiness agro-industrial attachments, KVK internships and preparation for Rajasthan Agriculture Supervisor, AAO, Pre-PG, ICAR JRF and IBPS AFO competitive examinations. Graduates pursue roles in seed, fertilizer, crop-protection, micro-irrigation, agri-fintech, warehousing and rural banking sectors, as well as M.Sc. Agriculture through Rajasthan Pre-PG and CUET-PG.

faqs.question: How does admission to MU Chittorgarh work?
faqs.answer: Admission to agriculture programmes at Mewar University, Chittorgarh is conducted through Rajasthan JET / CUET (UG) / MUEE, alongside direct university merit counselling for eligible 10+2 Agriculture/Science candidates. Both Rajasthan JET state counselling seats and university-level seats require verification of Class XII subject combinations (PCB, PCM, PCA or Agriculture) and original academic certificates at reporting. Check Rajasthan JET or University Application Window: Register through the official Mewar University, Chittorgarh admissions portal (https://www.mewaruniversity.org/pages/Agriculture_and_Veterinary_Science.aspx) or select the institution during Rajasthan JET / Pre-PG choice filling. Submit Academic & Entrance Score Details: Provide Class X and XII mark sheets (or B.Sc. Agriculture transcript for PG), JET/CUET/University entrance scorecard and category certificate. Document Verification & Tuition Fee Confirmation: Verify original documents on campus at Chittorgarh and obtain the itemised semester/annual fee receipt including hostel and examination heads.

faqs.question: What practical learning is described at MU Chittorgarh?
faqs.answer: Rural Agricultural Work Experience (RAWE) in adopted villages during the final year. Experiential Learning Programme (ELP) modules in organic inputs, nursery management, Mushroom cultivation and seed production. Field visits to Krishi Vigyan Kendras (KVKs), state agricultural research stations and agri-input processing plants in Rajasthan.

faqs.question: Which teaching facilities are documented at MU Chittorgarh?
faqs.answer: Agronomy & Instructional Crop Farm: Field demonstration plots at Chittorgarh for kharif and rabi crop trials, seed bed preparation, weed management and micro-irrigation exercises. Soil Science & Agricultural Chemistry Lab: Equipped for soil pH, electrical conductivity, organic carbon, macronutrient (N-P-K) and micronutrient testing. Horticulture, Polyhouse & Orchard Unit: Protected cultivation polyhouse/shade-net house, fruit orchard nursery and post-harvest handling practical space. Plant Pathology, Entomology & Genetics Labs: Compound and stereo microscopy, insect rearing cages, disease specimen collection and seed purity testing equipment. Student Hostels, Library & Transport: Separate boys and girls residential hostels at Chittorgarh, agricultural library journals, mess and city bus connectivity.

faqs.question: How does admission to PAHER Udaipur work?
faqs.answer: Admission to agriculture programmes at Pacific University, Udaipur is conducted through Rajasthan JET / Pacific University Entrance Test, alongside direct university merit counselling for eligible 10+2 Agriculture/Science candidates. Both Rajasthan JET state counselling seats and university-level seats require verification of Class XII subject combinations (PCB, PCM, PCA or Agriculture) and original academic certificates at reporting. Check Rajasthan JET or University Application Window: Register through the official Pacific University, Udaipur admissions portal (https://www.pacific-university.ac.in/College-of-Agriculture) or select the institution during Rajasthan JET / Pre-PG choice filling. Submit Academic & Entrance Score Details: Provide Class X and XII mark sheets (or B.Sc. Agriculture transcript for PG), JET/CUET/University entrance scorecard and category certificate. Document Verification & Tuition Fee Confirmation: Verify original documents on campus at Udaipur and obtain the itemised semester/annual fee receipt including hostel and examination heads.

faqs.question: What practical learning is described at PAHER Udaipur?
faqs.answer: Rural Agricultural Work Experience (RAWE) in adopted villages during the final year. Experiential Learning Programme (ELP) modules in organic inputs, nursery management, Mushroom cultivation and seed production. faqs.question: Which teaching facilities are documented at PAHER Udaipur?
faqs.answer: Agronomy & Instructional Crop Farm: Field demonstration plots at Udaipur for kharif and rabi crop trials, seed bed preparation, weed management and micro-irrigation exercises. Soil Science & Agricultural Chemistry Lab: Equipped for soil pH, electrical conductivity, organic carbon, macronutrient (N-P-K) and micronutrient testing. Horticulture, Polyhouse & Orchard Unit: Protected cultivation polyhouse/shade-net house, fruit orchard nursery and post-harvest handling practical space. Plant Pathology, Entomology & Genetics Labs: Compound and stereo microscopy, insect rearing cages, disease specimen collection and seed purity testing equipment. Student Hostels, Library & Transport: Separate boys and girls residential hostels at Udaipur, agricultural library journals, mess and city bus connectivity.

faqs.question: What student facilities are documented for PAHER Udaipur?

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for PAHER Udaipur?
faqs.answer: Pacific University, Udaipur offers merit-based tuition scholarships based on Class XII / qualifying examination marks or JET rank, alongside Rajasthan government post-matric scholarships (SJMS / Samaj Kalyan Vibhag) for eligible SC, ST, OBC, MBC and EBC students. University Entrance & Qualifying Marks Merit Scholarship (2026-27): Tuition fee waiver slabs (10% to 50% in first year) for applicants scoring 75%+ to 90%+ in 10+2 or high rank in Rajasthan JET / CUET; continuation requires maintaining minimum SGPA and 75% attendance. Rajasthan State Post-Matric & Girl Child Agriculture Incentive: Eligible Rajasthan domicile students can apply on the Rajasthan SSO Scholarship Portal; girl students in agriculture may also check state Rajshree / Agriculture Department incentive schemes.

faqs.question: What training and outcome evidence is available for PAHER Udaipur?
faqs.answer: The placement and training cell at Pacific University, Udaipur coordinates final-year agribusiness agro-industrial attachments, KVK internships and preparation for Rajasthan Agriculture Supervisor, AAO, Pre-PG, ICAR JRF and IBPS AFO competitive examinations. Graduates pursue roles in seed, fertilizer, crop-protection, micro-irrigation, agri-fintech, warehousing and rural banking sectors, as well as M.Sc. Agriculture through Rajasthan Pre-PG and CUET-PG.

paragraphs: Admission to agriculture programmes at Sangam University, Bhilwara is conducted through Rajasthan JET / CUET / Sangam University Merit, alongside direct university merit counselling for eligible 10+2 Agriculture/Science candidates.

faqs.question: How long is B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at SU Bhilwara?
faqs.answer: 4 years; study format: Full-time on campus. B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at Sangam University, Bhilwara is delivered on campus through the School of Agricultural Science and Technology (SOAST), combining classroom agronomy, laboratory practicals and field crop rotations.

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for SU Bhilwara?
faqs.answer: Sangam University, Bhilwara offers merit-based tuition scholarships based on Class XII / qualifying examination marks or JET rank, alongside Rajasthan government post-matric scholarships (SJMS / Samaj Kalyan Vibhag) for eligible SC, ST, OBC, MBC and EBC students. University Entrance & Qualifying Marks Merit Scholarship (2026-27): Tuition fee waiver slabs (10% to 50% in first year) for applicants scoring 75%+ to 90%+ in 10+2 or high rank in Rajasthan JET / CUET; continuation requires maintaining minimum SGPA and 75% attendance. Rajasthan State Post-Matric & Girl Child Agriculture Incentive: Eligible Rajasthan domicile students can apply on the Rajasthan SSO Scholarship Portal; girl students in agriculture may also check state Rajshree / Agriculture Department incentive schemes.

faqs.question: How does admission to SU Bhilwara work?
faqs.answer: Admission to agriculture programmes at Sangam University, Bhilwara is conducted through Rajasthan JET / CUET / Sangam University Merit, alongside direct university merit counselling for eligible 10+2 Agriculture/Science candidates. Both Rajasthan JET state counselling seats and university-level seats require verification of Class XII subject combinations (PCB, PCM, PCA or Agriculture) and original academic certificates at reporting. Check Rajasthan JET or University Application Window: Register through the official Sangam University, Bhilwara admissions portal (https://www.sangamuniversity.ac.in/school-of-agricultural-science-and-technology.php) or select the institution during Rajasthan JET / Pre-PG choice filling. Submit Academic & Entrance Score Details: Provide Class X and XII mark sheets (or B.Sc. Agriculture transcript for PG), JET/CUET/University entrance scorecard and category certificate. Document Verification & Tuition Fee Confirmation: Verify original documents on campus at Bhilwara and obtain the itemised semester/annual fee receipt including hostel and examination heads.

faqs.answer: Rajasthan JET / University UG Admission Session · 2026-07-31 · 2026-27. These are the dates of the named events; an earlier deadline does not establish a current opening.

faqs.question: How does admission to SU Bhilwara work?
faqs.answer: Admission to agriculture programmes at Sangam University, Bhilwara is conducted through Rajasthan JET / CUET / Sangam University Merit, alongside direct university merit counselling for eligible 10+2 Agriculture/Science candidates. Both Rajasthan JET state counselling seats and university-level seats require verification of Class XII subject combinations (PCB, PCM, PCA or Agriculture) and original academic certificates at reporting. Check Rajasthan JET or University Application Window: Register through the official Sangam University, Bhilwara admissions portal (https://www.sangamuniversity.ac.in/school-of-agricultural-science-and-technology.php) or select the institution during Rajasthan JET / Pre-PG choice filling. Submit Academic & Entrance Score Details: Provide Class X and XII mark sheets (or B.Sc. Agriculture transcript for PG), JET/CUET/University entrance scorecard and category certificate. Document Verification & Tuition Fee Confirmation: Verify original documents on campus at Bhilwara and obtain the itemised semester/annual fee receipt including hostel and examination heads.

faqs.question: Which teaching facilities are documented at SU Bhilwara?
faqs.answer: Agronomy & Instructional Crop Farm: Field demonstration plots at Bhilwara for kharif and rabi crop trials, seed bed preparation, weed management and micro-irrigation exercises. Soil Science & Agricultural Chemistry Lab: Equipped for soil pH, electrical conductivity, organic carbon, macronutrient (N-P-K) and micronutrient testing. Horticulture, Polyhouse & Orchard Unit: Protected cultivation polyhouse/shade-net house, fruit orchard nursery and post-harvest handling practical space. Plant Pathology, Entomology & Genetics Labs: Compound and stereo microscopy, insect rearing cages, disease specimen collection and seed purity testing equipment. Student Hostels, Library & Transport: Separate boys and girls residential hostels at Bhilwara, agricultural library journals, mess and city bus connectivity.

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for SU Bhilwara?

University Entrance & Qualifying Marks Merit Scholarship (2026-27): Tuition fee waiver slabs (10% to 50% in first year) for applicants scoring 75%+ to 90%+ in 10+2 or high rank in Rajasthan JET / CUET; continuation requires maintaining minimum SGPA and 75% attendance. Rajasthan State Post-Matric & Girl Child Agriculture Incentive: Eligible Rajasthan domicile students can apply on the Rajasthan SSO Scholarship Portal; girl students in agriculture may also check state Rajshree / Agriculture Department incentive schemes.

faqs.question: What training and outcome evidence is available for SU Bhilwara?
faqs.answer: The placement and training cell at Sangam University, Bhilwara coordinates final-year agribusiness agro-industrial attachments, KVK internships and preparation for Rajasthan Agriculture Supervisor, AAO, Pre-PG, ICAR JRF and IBPS AFO competitive examinations. Graduates pursue roles in seed, fertilizer, crop-protection, micro-irrigation, agri-fintech, warehousing and rural banking sectors, as well as M.Sc. Agriculture through Rajasthan Pre-PG and CUET-PG.

faqs.question: How does admission to MJRPU Jaipur work?
faqs.answer: Admission to agriculture programmes at Mahatma Jyoti Rao Phoole University, Jaipur is conducted through Rajasthan JET / MJRPU Merit Selection, alongside direct university merit counselling for eligible 10+2 Agriculture/Science candidates. Both Rajasthan JET state counselling seats and university-level seats require verification of Class XII subject combinations (PCB, PCM, PCA or Agriculture) and original academic certificates at reporting. Check Rajasthan JET or University Application Window: Register through the official Mahatma Jyoti Rao Phoole University, Jaipur admissions portal (https://mjrpuniversity.ac.in/department/agriculture) or select the institution during Rajasthan JET / Pre-PG choice filling. Submit Academic & Entrance Score Details: Provide Class X and XII mark sheets (or B.Sc. Agriculture transcript for PG), JET/CUET/University entrance scorecard and category certificate. Document Verification & Tuition Fee Confirmation: Verify original documents on campus at Jaipur and obtain the itemised semester/annual fee receipt including hostel and examination heads.

faqs.answer: Admission to agriculture programmes at Mahatma Jyoti Rao Phoole University, Jaipur is conducted through Rajasthan JET / MJRPU Merit Selection, alongside direct university merit counselling for eligible 10+2 Agriculture/Science candidates. Both Rajasthan JET state counselling seats and university-level seats require verification of Class XII subject combinations (PCB, PCM, PCA or Agriculture) and original academic certificates at reporting. Check Rajasthan JET or University Application Window: Register through the official Mahatma Jyoti Rao Phoole University, Jaipur admissions portal (https://mjrpuniversity.ac.in/department/agriculture) or select the institution during Rajasthan JET / Pre-PG choice filling. faqs.question: What is the recorded ICAR scope for MJRPU Jaipur?

This entry applies to the named unit and programme.

faqs.question: What practical learning is described at MJRPU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Rural Agricultural Work Experience (RAWE) in adopted villages during the final year. Experiential Learning Programme (ELP) modules in organic inputs, nursery management, Mushroom cultivation and seed production. Field visits to Krishi Vigyan Kendras (KVKs), state agricultural research stations and agri-input processing plants in Rajasthan.

faqs.question: Which teaching facilities are documented at MJRPU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Agronomy & Instructional Crop Farm: Field demonstration plots at Jaipur for kharif and rabi crop trials, seed bed preparation, weed management and micro-irrigation exercises. Soil Science & Agricultural Chemistry Lab: Equipped for soil pH, electrical conductivity, organic carbon, macronutrient (N-P-K) and micronutrient testing. Horticulture, Polyhouse & Orchard Unit: Protected cultivation polyhouse/shade-net house, fruit orchard nursery and post-harvest handling practical space. Plant Pathology, Entomology & Genetics Labs: Compound and stereo microscopy, insect rearing cages, disease specimen collection and seed purity testing equipment. Student Hostels, Library & Transport: Separate boys and girls residential hostels at Jaipur, agricultural library journals, mess and city bus connectivity.

faqs.question: What student facilities are documented for MJRPU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Student Hostels, Library & Transport: Separate boys and girls residential hostels at Jaipur, agricultural library journals, mess and city bus connectivity.

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for MJRPU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Mahatma Jyoti Rao Phoole University, Jaipur offers merit-based tuition scholarships based on Class XII / qualifying examination marks or JET rank, alongside Rajasthan government post-matric scholarships (SJMS / Samaj Kalyan Vibhag) for eligible SC, ST, OBC, MBC and EBC students. University Entrance & Qualifying Marks Merit Scholarship (2026-27): Tuition fee waiver slabs (10% to 50% in first year) for applicants scoring 75%+ to 90%+ in 10+2 or high rank in Rajasthan JET / CUET; continuation requires maintaining minimum SGPA and 75% attendance. Rajasthan State Post-Matric & Girl Child Agriculture Incentive: Eligible Rajasthan domicile students can apply on the Rajasthan SSO Scholarship Portal; girl students in agriculture may also check state Rajshree / Agriculture Department incentive schemes.

faqs.question: What training and outcome evidence is available for MJRPU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: The placement and training cell at Mahatma Jyoti Rao Phoole University, Jaipur coordinates final-year agribusiness agro-industrial attachments, KVK internships and preparation for Rajasthan Agriculture Supervisor, AAO, Pre-PG, ICAR JRF and IBPS AFO competitive examinations. Graduates pursue roles in seed, fertilizer, crop-protection, micro-irrigation, agri-fintech, warehousing and rural banking sectors, as well as M.Sc. Agriculture through Rajasthan Pre-PG and CUET-PG.

faqs.question: How does admission to BU Ajmer work?
faqs.answer: Admission to agriculture programmes at Bhagwant University, Ajmer is conducted through Rajasthan JET / UJET (University Joint Entrance Test), alongside direct university merit counselling for eligible 10+2 Agriculture/Science candidates. Both Rajasthan JET state counselling seats and university-level seats require verification of Class XII subject combinations (PCB, PCM, PCA or Agriculture) and original academic certificates at reporting. Check Rajasthan JET or University Application Window: Register through the official Bhagwant University, Ajmer admissions portal (https://bhagwantuniversity.ac.in/agriculture/) or select the institution during Rajasthan JET / Pre-PG choice filling. Submit Academic & Entrance Score Details: Provide Class X and XII mark sheets (or B.Sc. Agriculture transcript for PG), JET/CUET/University entrance scorecard and category certificate. Document Verification & Tuition Fee Confirmation: Verify original documents on campus at Ajmer and obtain the itemised semester/annual fee receipt including hostel and examination heads.

faqs.question: Which teaching facilities are documented at BU Ajmer?
faqs.answer: Agronomy & Instructional Crop Farm: Field demonstration plots at Ajmer for kharif and rabi crop trials, seed bed preparation, weed management and micro-irrigation exercises. Soil Science & Agricultural Chemistry Lab: Equipped for soil pH, electrical conductivity, organic carbon, macronutrient (N-P-K) and micronutrient testing. Horticulture, Polyhouse & Orchard Unit: Protected cultivation polyhouse/shade-net house, fruit orchard nursery and post-harvest handling practical space. Plant Pathology, Entomology & Genetics Labs: Compound and stereo microscopy, insect rearing cages, disease specimen collection and seed purity testing equipment. Student Hostels, Library & Transport: Separate boys and girls residential hostels at Ajmer, agricultural library journals, mess and city bus connectivity.

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for BU Ajmer?
faqs.answer: Bhagwant University, Ajmer offers merit-based tuition scholarships based on Class XII / qualifying examination marks or JET rank, alongside Rajasthan government post-matric scholarships (SJMS / Samaj Kalyan Vibhag) for eligible SC, ST, OBC, MBC and EBC students. University Entrance & Qualifying Marks Merit Scholarship (2026-27): Tuition fee waiver slabs (10% to 50% in first year) for applicants scoring 75%+ to 90%+ in 10+2 or high rank in Rajasthan JET / CUET; continuation requires maintaining minimum SGPA and 75% attendance. Rajasthan State Post-Matric & Girl Child Agriculture Incentive: Eligible Rajasthan domicile students can apply on the Rajasthan SSO Scholarship Portal; girl students in agriculture may also check state Rajshree / Agriculture Department incentive schemes.

faqs.question: What training and outcome evidence is available for BU Ajmer?
faqs.answer: The placement and training cell at Bhagwant University, Ajmer coordinates final-year agribusiness agro-industrial attachments, KVK internships and preparation for Rajasthan Agriculture Supervisor, AAO, Pre-PG, ICAR JRF and IBPS AFO competitive examinations. Graduates pursue roles in seed, fertilizer, crop-protection, micro-irrigation, agri-fintech, warehousing and rural banking sectors, as well as M.Sc. Agriculture through Rajasthan Pre-PG and CUET-PG.

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for NU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Nirwan University, Jaipur offers merit-based tuition scholarships based on Class XII / qualifying examination marks or JET rank, alongside Rajasthan government post-matric scholarships (SJMS / Samaj Kalyan Vibhag) for eligible SC, ST, OBC, MBC and EBC students. University Entrance & Qualifying Marks Merit Scholarship (2026-27): Tuition fee waiver slabs (10% to 50% in first year) for applicants scoring 75%+ to 90%+ in 10+2 or high rank in Rajasthan JET / CUET; continuation requires maintaining minimum SGPA and 75% attendance. Rajasthan State Post-Matric & Girl Child Agriculture Incentive: Eligible Rajasthan domicile students can apply on the Rajasthan SSO Scholarship Portal; girl students in agriculture may also check state Rajshree / Agriculture Department incentive schemes.

faqs.question: How does admission to NU Jaipur work?
faqs.answer: Admission to agriculture programmes at Nirwan University, Jaipur is conducted through Rajasthan JET / Nirwan University Entrance & Merit, alongside direct university merit counselling for eligible 10+2 Agriculture/Science candidates. Both Rajasthan JET state counselling seats and university-level seats require verification of Class XII subject combinations (PCB, PCM, PCA or Agriculture) and original academic certificates at reporting. Check Rajasthan JET or University Application Window: Register through the official Nirwan University, Jaipur admissions portal (https://www.nirwanuniversity.ac.in/school/school-of-agricultural-sciences) or select the institution during Rajasthan JET / Pre-PG choice filling. Submit Academic & Entrance Score Details: Provide Class X and XII mark sheets (or B.Sc. Agriculture transcript for PG), JET/CUET/University entrance scorecard and category certificate. Document Verification & Tuition Fee Confirmation: Verify original documents on campus at Jaipur and obtain the itemised semester/annual fee receipt including hostel and examination heads.

faqs.answer: Rajasthan JET / University UG Admission Session · 2026-07-31 · 2026-27. These are the dates of the named events; an earlier deadline does not establish a current opening.

faqs.question: How does admission to NU Jaipur work?
faqs.answer: Admission to agriculture programmes at Nirwan University, Jaipur is conducted through Rajasthan JET / Nirwan University Entrance & Merit, alongside direct university merit counselling for eligible 10+2 Agriculture/Science candidates. Both Rajasthan JET state counselling seats and university-level seats require verification of Class XII subject combinations (PCB, PCM, PCA or Agriculture) and original academic certificates at reporting. Check Rajasthan JET or University Application Window: Register through the official Nirwan University, Jaipur admissions portal (https://www.nirwanuniversity.ac.in/school/school-of-agricultural-sciences) or select the institution during Rajasthan JET / Pre-PG choice filling. Submit Academic & Entrance Score Details: Provide Class X and XII mark sheets (or B.Sc. Agriculture transcript for PG), JET/CUET/University entrance scorecard and category certificate. Document Verification & Tuition Fee Confirmation: Verify original documents on campus at Jaipur and obtain the itemised semester/annual fee receipt including hostel and examination heads.

faqs.question: What practical learning is described at NU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Rural Agricultural Work Experience (RAWE) in adopted villages during the final year. Experiential Learning Programme (ELP) modules in organic inputs, nursery management, Mushroom cultivation and seed production. Field visits to Krishi Vigyan Kendras (KVKs), state agricultural research stations and agri-input processing plants in Rajasthan.

faqs.question: Which teaching facilities are documented at NU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Agronomy & Instructional Crop Farm: Field demonstration plots at Jaipur for kharif and rabi crop trials, seed bed preparation, weed management and micro-irrigation exercises. Soil Science & Agricultural Chemistry Lab: Equipped for soil pH, electrical conductivity, organic carbon, macronutrient (N-P-K) and micronutrient testing. Horticulture, Polyhouse & Orchard Unit: Protected cultivation polyhouse/shade-net house, fruit orchard nursery and post-harvest handling practical space. Plant Pathology, Entomology & Genetics Labs: Compound and stereo microscopy, insect rearing cages, disease specimen collection and seed purity testing equipment. Student Hostels, Library & Transport: Separate boys and girls residential hostels at Jaipur, agricultural library journals, mess and city bus connectivity.

faqs.question: What student facilities are documented for NU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Student Hostels, Library & Transport: Separate boys and girls residential hostels at Jaipur, agricultural library journals, mess and city bus connectivity.

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for NU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Nirwan University, Jaipur offers merit-based tuition scholarships based on Class XII / qualifying examination marks or JET rank, alongside Rajasthan government post-matric scholarships (SJMS / Samaj Kalyan Vibhag) for eligible SC, ST, OBC, MBC and EBC students. University Entrance & Qualifying Marks Merit Scholarship (2026-27): Tuition fee waiver slabs (10% to 50% in first year) for applicants scoring 75%+ to 90%+ in 10+2 or high rank in Rajasthan JET / CUET; continuation requires maintaining minimum SGPA and 75% attendance. Rajasthan State Post-Matric & Girl Child Agriculture Incentive: Eligible Rajasthan domicile students can apply on the Rajasthan SSO Scholarship Portal; girl students in agriculture may also check state Rajshree / Agriculture Department incentive schemes.

faqs.question: What training and outcome evidence is available for NU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: The placement and training cell at Nirwan University, Jaipur coordinates final-year agribusiness agro-industrial attachments, KVK internships and preparation for Rajasthan Agriculture Supervisor, AAO, Pre-PG, ICAR JRF and IBPS AFO competitive examinations. Graduates pursue roles in seed, fertilizer, crop-protection, micro-irrigation, agri-fintech, warehousing and rural banking sectors, as well as M.Sc. Agriculture through Rajasthan Pre-PG and CUET-PG.

faqs.answer: Admission to agriculture programmes at Jayoti Vidyapeeth Women's University, Jaipur is conducted through Rajasthan JET / JNEE (Women University Entrance), alongside direct university merit counselling for eligible 10+2 Agriculture/Science candidates. Both Rajasthan JET state counselling seats and university-level seats require verification of Class XII subject combinations (PCB, PCM, PCA or Agriculture) and original academic certificates at reporting. faqs.question: How does admission to JVWU Jaipur work?
faqs.answer: Admission to agriculture programmes at Jayoti Vidyapeeth Women's University, Jaipur is conducted through Rajasthan JET / JNEE (Women University Entrance), alongside direct university merit counselling for eligible 10+2 Agriculture/Science candidates. Both Rajasthan JET state counselling seats and university-level seats require verification of Class XII subject combinations (PCB, PCM, PCA or Agriculture) and original academic certificates at reporting. Check Rajasthan JET or University Application Window: Register through the official Jayoti Vidyapeeth Women's University, Jaipur admissions portal (https://www.jvwu.ac.in/faculty-of-agriculture-and-veterinary-science.html) or select the institution during Rajasthan JET / Pre-PG choice filling. Submit Academic & Entrance Score Details: Provide Class X and XII mark sheets (or B.Sc. Agriculture transcript for PG), JET/CUET/University entrance scorecard and category certificate. Document Verification & Tuition Fee Confirmation: Verify original documents on campus at Jaipur and obtain the itemised semester/annual fee receipt including hostel and examination heads.

faqs.answer: Published phone: 18005722266. Published email: admission@jvwu.ac.in. Official admissions: https://www.jvwu.ac.in/faculty-of-agriculture-and-veterinary-science.html

faqs.question: Which agriculture or allied programmes are covered at JVWU Jaipur?

faqs.question: What practical learning is described at JVWU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Rural Agricultural Work Experience (RAWE) in adopted villages during the final year. Experiential Learning Programme (ELP) modules in organic inputs, nursery management, Mushroom cultivation and seed production. Field visits to Krishi Vigyan Kendras (KVKs), state agricultural research stations and agri-input processing plants in Rajasthan.

faqs.question: Which teaching facilities are documented at JVWU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Agronomy & Instructional Crop Farm: Field demonstration plots at Jaipur for kharif and rabi crop trials, seed bed preparation, weed management and micro-irrigation exercises. Soil Science & Agricultural Chemistry Lab: Equipped for soil pH, electrical conductivity, organic carbon, macronutrient (N-P-K) and micronutrient testing. Horticulture, Polyhouse & Orchard Unit: Protected cultivation polyhouse/shade-net house, fruit orchard nursery and post-harvest handling practical space. Plant Pathology, Entomology & Genetics Labs: Compound and stereo microscopy, insect rearing cages, disease specimen collection and seed purity testing equipment. Student Hostels, Library & Transport: Separate boys and girls residential hostels at Jaipur, agricultural library journals, mess and city bus connectivity.

faqs.question: What student facilities are documented for JVWU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Student Hostels, Library & Transport: Separate boys and girls residential hostels at Jaipur, agricultural library journals, mess and city bus connectivity.

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for JVWU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Jayoti Vidyapeeth Women's University, Jaipur offers merit-based tuition scholarships based on Class XII / qualifying examination marks or JET rank, alongside Rajasthan government post-matric scholarships (SJMS / Samaj Kalyan Vibhag) for eligible SC, ST, OBC, MBC and EBC students. University Entrance & Qualifying Marks Merit Scholarship (2026-27): Tuition fee waiver slabs (10% to 50% in first year) for applicants scoring 75%+ to 90%+ in 10+2 or high rank in Rajasthan JET / CUET; continuation requires maintaining minimum SGPA and 75% attendance. Rajasthan State Post-Matric & Girl Child Agriculture Incentive: Eligible Rajasthan domicile students can apply on the Rajasthan SSO Scholarship Portal; girl students in agriculture may also check state Rajshree / Agriculture Department incentive schemes.

faqs.question: What training and outcome evidence is available for JVWU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: The placement and training cell at Jayoti Vidyapeeth Women's University, Jaipur coordinates final-year agribusiness agro-industrial attachments, KVK internships and preparation for Rajasthan Agriculture Supervisor, AAO, Pre-PG, ICAR JRF and IBPS AFO competitive examinations. Graduates pursue roles in seed, fertilizer, crop-protection, micro-irrigation, agri-fintech, warehousing and rural banking sectors, as well as M.Sc. Agriculture through Rajasthan Pre-PG and CUET-PG.

faqs.question: How does admission to Amity Jaipur work?
faqs.answer: Admission to agriculture programmes at Amity University Rajasthan, Jaipur is conducted through CUET (UG) / Amity Application & Personal Interview, alongside direct university merit counselling for eligible 10+2 Agriculture/Science candidates. Document Verification & Tuition Fee Confirmation: Verify original documents on campus at Jaipur and obtain the itemised semester/annual fee receipt including hostel and examination heads.

faqs.question: What practical learning is described at Amity Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Rural Agricultural Work Experience (RAWE) in adopted villages during the final year. Experiential Learning Programme (ELP) modules in organic inputs, nursery management, Mushroom cultivation and seed production. Field visits to Krishi Vigyan Kendras (KVKs), state agricultural research stations and agri-input processing plants in Rajasthan.

faqs.question: Which teaching facilities are documented at Amity Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Agronomy & Instructional Crop Farm: Field demonstration plots at Jaipur for kharif and rabi crop trials, seed bed preparation, weed management and micro-irrigation exercises. Soil Science & Agricultural Chemistry Lab: Equipped for soil pH, electrical conductivity, organic carbon, macronutrient (N-P-K) and micronutrient testing. Horticulture, Polyhouse & Orchard Unit: Protected cultivation polyhouse/shade-net house, fruit orchard nursery and post-harvest handling practical space. Plant Pathology, Entomology & Genetics Labs: Compound and stereo microscopy, insect rearing cages, disease specimen collection and seed purity testing equipment. Student Hostels, Library & Transport: Separate boys and girls residential hostels at Jaipur, agricultural library journals, mess and city bus connectivity.

faqs.question: What student facilities are documented for Amity Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Student Hostels, Library & Transport: Separate boys and girls residential hostels at Jaipur, agricultural library journals, mess and city bus connectivity.

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for Amity Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Amity University Rajasthan, Jaipur offers merit-based tuition scholarships based on Class XII / qualifying examination marks or JET rank, alongside Rajasthan government post-matric scholarships (SJMS / Samaj Kalyan Vibhag) for eligible SC, ST, OBC, MBC and EBC students. University Entrance & Qualifying Marks Merit Scholarship (2026-27): Tuition fee waiver slabs (10% to 50% in first year) for applicants scoring 75%+ to 90%+ in 10+2 or high rank in Rajasthan JET / CUET; continuation requires maintaining minimum SGPA and 75% attendance. Rajasthan State Post-Matric & Girl Child Agriculture Incentive: Eligible Rajasthan domicile students can apply on the Rajasthan SSO Scholarship Portal; girl students in agriculture may also check state Rajshree / Agriculture Department incentive schemes.

faqs.question: What training and outcome evidence is available for Amity Jaipur?
faqs.answer: The placement and training cell at Amity University Rajasthan, Jaipur coordinates final-year agribusiness agro-industrial attachments, KVK internships and preparation for Rajasthan Agriculture Supervisor, AAO, Pre-PG, ICAR JRF and IBPS AFO competitive examinations. Graduates pursue roles in seed, fertilizer, crop-protection, micro-irrigation, agri-fintech, warehousing and rural banking sectors, as well as M.Sc. Agriculture through Rajasthan Pre-PG and CUET-PG.

Both Rajasthan JET state counselling seats and university-level seats require verification of Class XII subject combinations (PCB, PCM, PCA or Agriculture) and original academic certificates at reporting. Check Rajasthan JET or University Application Window: Register through the official Shyam University, Dausa admissions portal (https://shyamuniversity.in/agriculture/) or select the institution during Rajasthan JET / Pre-PG choice filling. Submit Academic & Entrance Score Details: Provide Class X and XII mark sheets (or B.Sc. Agriculture transcript for PG), JET/CUET/University entrance scorecard and category certificate. Document Verification & Tuition Fee Confirmation: Verify original documents on campus at Dausa and obtain the itemised semester/annual fee receipt including hostel and examination heads.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at SU Dausa?
faqs.answer: 10+2 with Agriculture or Science (PCB / PCM) from a recognized board.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for M.Sc. Agriculture (Agronomy) at SU Dausa?
faqs.answer: 4-year B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture from a recognized university.

faqs.question: Which application documents does SU Dausa list?
faqs.answer: Class X mark sheet and certificate (date of birth proof).; Class XII mark sheet and passing certificate with Agriculture / PCB / PCM.; Rajasthan JET / Pre-PG / CUET / University entrance rank card.; Transfer Certificate (TC) and Migration Certificate.; Domicile and Caste/Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/MBC/EWS where applicable).; Aadhaar card, ABC/APAAR ID and 6 passport-size photographs.. Check the applicable notice for originals, formats and category-specific certificates.

Graduates pursue roles in seed, fertilizer, crop-protection, micro-irrigation, agri-fintech, warehousing and rural banking sectors, as well as M.Sc. Agriculture through Rajasthan Pre-PG and CUET-PG.

faqs.question: What practical learning is described at SU Dausa?
faqs.answer: Rural Agricultural Work Experience (RAWE) in adopted villages during the final year. Experiential Learning Programme (ELP) modules in organic inputs, nursery management, Mushroom cultivation and seed production. Field visits to Krishi Vigyan Kendras (KVKs), state agricultural research stations and agri-input processing plants in Rajasthan.

faqs.question: Which employers or training organisations are named for SU Dausa?

faqs.question: Which teaching facilities are documented at SU Dausa?
faqs.answer: Agronomy & Instructional Crop Farm: Field demonstration plots at Dausa for kharif and rabi crop trials, seed bed preparation, weed management and micro-irrigation exercises. Soil Science & Agricultural Chemistry Lab: Equipped for soil pH, electrical conductivity, organic carbon, macronutrient (N-P-K) and micronutrient testing. Horticulture, Polyhouse & Orchard Unit: Protected cultivation polyhouse/shade-net house, fruit orchard nursery and post-harvest handling practical space. Plant Pathology, Entomology & Genetics Labs: Compound and stereo microscopy, insect rearing cages, disease specimen collection and seed purity testing equipment. Student Hostels, Library & Transport: Separate boys and girls residential hostels at Dausa, agricultural library journals, mess and city bus connectivity.

faqs.question: How does admission to SU Dausa work?
faqs.answer: Admission to agriculture programmes at Shyam University, Dausa is conducted through Rajasthan JET / University Merit Admission, alongside direct university merit counselling for eligible 10+2 Agriculture/Science candidates. Both Rajasthan JET state counselling seats and university-level seats require verification of Class XII subject combinations (PCB, PCM, PCA or Agriculture) and original academic certificates at reporting. Check Rajasthan JET or University Application Window: Register through the official Shyam University, Dausa admissions portal (https://shyamuniversity.in/agriculture/) or select the institution during Rajasthan JET / Pre-PG choice filling. Document Verification & Tuition Fee Confirmation: Verify original documents on campus at Dausa and obtain the itemised semester/annual fee receipt including hostel and examination heads.

faqs.question: How does admission to SU Dausa work?
faqs.answer: Admission to agriculture programmes at Shyam University, Dausa is conducted through Rajasthan JET / University Merit Admission, alongside direct university merit counselling for eligible 10+2 Agriculture/Science candidates. Both Rajasthan JET state counselling seats and university-level seats require verification of Class XII subject combinations (PCB, PCM, PCA or Agriculture) and original academic certificates at reporting. Check Rajasthan JET or University Application Window: Register through the official Shyam University, Dausa admissions portal (https://shyamuniversity.in/agriculture/) or select the institution during Rajasthan JET / Pre-PG choice filling. Submit Academic & Entrance Score Details: Provide Class X and XII mark sheets (or B.Sc. Agriculture transcript for PG), JET/CUET/University entrance scorecard and category certificate. Document Verification & Tuition Fee Confirmation: Verify original documents on campus at Dausa and obtain the itemised semester/annual fee receipt including hostel and examination heads.

faqs.question: What is the recorded ICAR scope for SU Dausa?
faqs.answer: Department of Agriculture, Shyam University, Dausa: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture; M.Sc. Agriculture (Agronomy), recorded term 2022-23 to 2026-27 (UGC / State University Act & Rajasthan JET participating faculty; check ICAR NAEAB cohort notice). This entry applies to the named unit and programme.

faqs.question: What practical learning is described at SU Dausa?
faqs.answer: Rural Agricultural Work Experience (RAWE) in adopted villages during the final year. Experiential Learning Programme (ELP) modules in organic inputs, nursery management, Mushroom cultivation and seed production. Field visits to Krishi Vigyan Kendras (KVKs), state agricultural research stations and agri-input processing plants in Rajasthan.

faqs.question: Which teaching facilities are documented at SU Dausa?
faqs.answer: Agronomy & Instructional Crop Farm: Field demonstration plots at Dausa for kharif and rabi crop trials, seed bed preparation, weed management and micro-irrigation exercises. Soil Science & Agricultural Chemistry Lab: Equipped for soil pH, electrical conductivity, organic carbon, macronutrient (N-P-K) and micronutrient testing. Horticulture, Polyhouse & Orchard Unit: Protected cultivation polyhouse/shade-net house, fruit orchard nursery and post-harvest handling practical space. Plant Pathology, Entomology & Genetics Labs: Compound and stereo microscopy, insect rearing cages, disease specimen collection and seed purity testing equipment. Student Hostels, Library & Transport: Separate boys and girls residential hostels at Dausa, agricultural library journals, mess and city bus connectivity.

faqs.question: What student facilities are documented for SU Dausa?
faqs.answer: Student Hostels, Library & Transport: Separate boys and girls residential hostels at Dausa, agricultural library journals, mess and city bus connectivity.

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for SU Dausa?
faqs.answer: Shyam University, Dausa offers merit-based tuition scholarships based on Class XII / qualifying examination marks or JET rank, alongside Rajasthan government post-matric scholarships (SJMS / Samaj Kalyan Vibhag) for eligible SC, ST, OBC, MBC and EBC students. University Entrance & Qualifying Marks Merit Scholarship (2026-27): Tuition fee waiver slabs (10% to 50% in first year) for applicants scoring 75%+ to 90%+ in 10+2 or high rank in Rajasthan JET / CUET; continuation requires maintaining minimum SGPA and 75% attendance. Rajasthan State Post-Matric & Girl Child Agriculture Incentive: Eligible Rajasthan domicile students can apply on the Rajasthan SSO Scholarship Portal; girl students in agriculture may also check state Rajshree / Agriculture Department incentive schemes.

faqs.question: What training and outcome evidence is available for SU Dausa?
faqs.answer: The placement and training cell at Shyam University, Dausa coordinates final-year agribusiness agro-industrial attachments, KVK internships and preparation for Rajasthan Agriculture Supervisor, AAO, Pre-PG, ICAR JRF and IBPS AFO competitive examinations. Graduates pursue roles in seed, fertilizer, crop-protection, micro-irrigation, agri-fintech, warehousing and rural banking sectors, as well as M.Sc. Agriculture through Rajasthan Pre-PG and CUET-PG.

faqs.question: How does admission to LU Alwar work?
faqs.answer: Admission to agriculture programmes at Lords University, Alwar is conducted through Rajasthan JET / CUET / Lords University Merit, alongside direct university merit counselling for eligible 10+2 Agriculture/Science candidates. Both Rajasthan JET state counselling seats and university-level seats require verification of Class XII subject combinations (PCB, PCM, PCA or Agriculture) and original academic certificates at reporting. Check Rajasthan JET or University Application Window: Register through the official Lords University, Alwar admissions portal (https://www.lordsuni.edu.in/department/faculty-of-agriculture) or select the institution during Rajasthan JET / Pre-PG choice filling. Submit Academic & Entrance Score Details: Provide Class X and XII mark sheets (or B.Sc. Agriculture transcript for PG), JET/CUET/University entrance scorecard and category certificate. Document Verification & Tuition Fee Confirmation: Verify original documents on campus at Alwar and obtain the itemised semester/annual fee receipt including hostel and examination heads.

faqs.question: How does admission to LU Alwar work?
faqs.answer: Admission to agriculture programmes at Lords University, Alwar is conducted through Rajasthan JET / CUET / Lords University Merit, alongside direct university merit counselling for eligible 10+2 Agriculture/Science candidates. Both Rajasthan JET state counselling seats and university-level seats require verification of Class XII subject combinations (PCB, PCM, PCA or Agriculture) and original academic certificates at reporting. Check Rajasthan JET or University Application Window: Register through the official Lords University, Alwar admissions portal (https://www.lordsuni.edu.in/department/faculty-of-agriculture) or select the institution during Rajasthan JET / Pre-PG choice filling. Submit Academic & Entrance Score Details: Provide Class X and XII mark sheets (or B.Sc. Agriculture transcript for PG), JET/CUET/University entrance scorecard and category certificate. Document Verification & Tuition Fee Confirmation: Verify original documents on campus at Alwar and obtain the itemised semester/annual fee receipt including hostel and examination heads.

faqs.question: What is the recorded ICAR scope for LU Alwar?
faqs.answer: Faculty of Agriculture, Lords University, Alwar: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture; M.Sc. Agriculture (Agronomy), recorded term 2022-23 to 2026-27 (UGC / State University Act & Rajasthan JET participating faculty; check ICAR NAEAB cohort notice). This entry applies to the named unit and programme.

faqs.question: What practical learning is described at LU Alwar?
faqs.answer: Rural Agricultural Work Experience (RAWE) in adopted villages during the final year. Experiential Learning Programme (ELP) modules in organic inputs, nursery management, Mushroom cultivation and seed production. Field visits to Krishi Vigyan Kendras (KVKs), state agricultural research stations and agri-input processing plants in Rajasthan.

faqs.question: Which teaching facilities are documented at LU Alwar?
faqs.answer: Agronomy & Instructional Crop Farm: Field demonstration plots at Alwar for kharif and rabi crop trials, seed bed preparation, weed management and micro-irrigation exercises. Soil Science & Agricultural Chemistry Lab: Equipped for soil pH, electrical conductivity, organic carbon, macronutrient (N-P-K) and micronutrient testing. Horticulture, Polyhouse & Orchard Unit: Protected cultivation polyhouse/shade-net house, fruit orchard nursery and post-harvest handling practical space. Plant Pathology, Entomology & Genetics Labs: Compound and stereo microscopy, insect rearing cages, disease specimen collection and seed purity testing equipment. Student Hostels, Library & Transport: Separate boys and girls residential hostels at Alwar, agricultural library journals, mess and city bus connectivity.

faqs.question: What student facilities are documented for LU Alwar?
faqs.answer: Student Hostels, Library & Transport: Separate boys and girls residential hostels at Alwar, agricultural library journals, mess and city bus connectivity.

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for LU Alwar?
faqs.answer: Lords University, Alwar offers merit-based tuition scholarships based on Class XII / qualifying examination marks or JET rank, alongside Rajasthan government post-matric scholarships (SJMS / Samaj Kalyan Vibhag) for eligible SC, ST, OBC, MBC and EBC students. University Entrance & Qualifying Marks Merit Scholarship (2026-27): Tuition fee waiver slabs (10% to 50% in first year) for applicants scoring 75%+ to 90%+ in 10+2 or high rank in Rajasthan JET / CUET; continuation requires maintaining minimum SGPA and 75% attendance. Rajasthan State Post-Matric & Girl Child Agriculture Incentive: Eligible Rajasthan domicile students can apply on the Rajasthan SSO Scholarship Portal; girl students in agriculture may also check state Rajshree / Agriculture Department incentive schemes.

faqs.question: What training and outcome evidence is available for LU Alwar?
faqs.answer: The placement and training cell at Lords University, Alwar coordinates final-year agribusiness agro-industrial attachments, KVK internships and preparation for Rajasthan Agriculture Supervisor, AAO, Pre-PG, ICAR JRF and IBPS AFO competitive examinations. Graduates pursue roles in seed, fertilizer, crop-protection, micro-irrigation, agri-fintech, warehousing and rural banking sectors, as well as M.Sc. Agriculture through Rajasthan Pre-PG and CUET-PG.

faqs.answer: Published phone: 7229809999. Published email: admissions@lordsuni.edu.in. Official admissions: https://www.lordsuni.edu.in/department/faculty-of-agriculture

faqs.question: How does admission to SRU Alwar work?
faqs.answer: Admission to agriculture programmes at Sunrise University, Alwar is conducted through Rajasthan JET / University Merit Admission, alongside direct university merit counselling for eligible 10+2 Agriculture/Science candidates. Both Rajasthan JET state counselling seats and university-level seats require verification of Class XII subject combinations (PCB, PCM, PCA or Agriculture) and original academic certificates at reporting. Check Rajasthan JET or University Application Window: Register through the official Sunrise University, Alwar admissions portal (https://www.sunriseuniversity.in/schools/school-of-agriculture) or select the institution during Rajasthan JET / Pre-PG choice filling. Document Verification & Tuition Fee Confirmation: Verify original documents on campus at Alwar and obtain the itemised semester/annual fee receipt including hostel and examination heads.

faqs.answer: Admission to agriculture programmes at Sunrise University, Alwar is conducted through Rajasthan JET / University Merit Admission, alongside direct university merit counselling for eligible 10+2 Agriculture/Science candidates. Both Rajasthan JET state counselling seats and university-level seats require verification of Class XII subject combinations (PCB, PCM, PCA or Agriculture) and original academic certificates at reporting. faqs.question: What practical learning is described at SRU Alwar?
faqs.answer: Rural Agricultural Work Experience (RAWE) in adopted villages during the final year. Experiential Learning Programme (ELP) modules in organic inputs, nursery management, Mushroom cultivation and seed production. Field visits to Krishi Vigyan Kendras (KVKs), state agricultural research stations and agri-input processing plants in Rajasthan.

faqs.question: Which teaching facilities are documented at SRU Alwar?
faqs.answer: Agronomy & Instructional Crop Farm: Field demonstration plots at Alwar for kharif and rabi crop trials, seed bed preparation, weed management and micro-irrigation exercises. Soil Science & Agricultural Chemistry Lab: Equipped for soil pH, electrical conductivity, organic carbon, macronutrient (N-P-K) and micronutrient testing. Horticulture, Polyhouse & Orchard Unit: Protected cultivation polyhouse/shade-net house, fruit orchard nursery and post-harvest handling practical space. Plant Pathology, Entomology & Genetics Labs: Compound and stereo microscopy, insect rearing cages, disease specimen collection and seed purity testing equipment. Student Hostels, Library & Transport: Separate boys and girls residential hostels at Alwar, agricultural library journals, mess and city bus connectivity.

faqs.question: What student facilities are documented for SRU Alwar?
faqs.answer: Student Hostels, Library & Transport: Separate boys and girls residential hostels at Alwar, agricultural library journals, mess and city bus connectivity.

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for SRU Alwar?
faqs.answer: Sunrise University, Alwar offers merit-based tuition scholarships based on Class XII / qualifying examination marks or JET rank, alongside Rajasthan government post-matric scholarships (SJMS / Samaj Kalyan Vibhag) for eligible SC, ST, OBC, MBC and EBC students. University Entrance & Qualifying Marks Merit Scholarship (2026-27): Tuition fee waiver slabs (10% to 50% in first year) for applicants scoring 75%+ to 90%+ in 10+2 or high rank in Rajasthan JET / CUET; continuation requires maintaining minimum SGPA and 75% attendance. Rajasthan State Post-Matric & Girl Child Agriculture Incentive: Eligible Rajasthan domicile students can apply on the Rajasthan SSO Scholarship Portal; girl students in agriculture may also check state Rajshree / Agriculture Department incentive schemes.

faqs.question: What training and outcome evidence is available for SRU Alwar?
faqs.answer: The placement and training cell at Sunrise University, Alwar coordinates final-year agribusiness agro-industrial attachments, KVK internships and preparation for Rajasthan Agriculture Supervisor, AAO, Pre-PG, ICAR JRF and IBPS AFO competitive examinations. Graduates pursue roles in seed, fertilizer, crop-protection, micro-irrigation, agri-fintech, warehousing and rural banking sectors, as well as M.Sc. Agriculture through Rajasthan Pre-PG and CUET-PG.

faqs.question: How does admission to SU Pilani work?
faqs.answer: Admission to agriculture programmes at Shridhar University, Pilani is conducted through Rajasthan JET / Shridhar University Merit, alongside direct university merit counselling for eligible 10+2 Agriculture/Science candidates. Both Rajasthan JET state counselling seats and university-level seats require verification of Class XII subject combinations (PCB, PCM, PCA or Agriculture) and original academic certificates at reporting. Check Rajasthan JET or University Application Window: Register through the official Shridhar University, Pilani admissions portal (https://www.shridharuniversity.ac.in/department-of-agriculture/) or select the institution during Rajasthan JET / Pre-PG choice filling. Submit Academic & Entrance Score Details: Provide Class X and XII mark sheets (or B.Sc. Agriculture transcript for PG), JET/CUET/University entrance scorecard and category certificate. Document Verification & Tuition Fee Confirmation: Verify original documents on campus at Pilani and obtain the itemised semester/annual fee receipt including hostel and examination heads.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at SU Pilani?
faqs.answer: 10+2 with Agriculture or Science (PCB / PCM) with minimum 45% marks.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for M.Sc. Agriculture (Agronomy) at SU Pilani?
faqs.answer: 4-year B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture from a recognized university.

faqs.question: Which application documents does SU Pilani list?
faqs.answer: Class X mark sheet and certificate (date of birth proof).; Class XII mark sheet and passing certificate with Agriculture / PCB / PCM.; Rajasthan JET / Pre-PG / CUET / University entrance rank card.; Transfer Certificate (TC) and Migration Certificate.; Domicile and Caste/Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/MBC/EWS where applicable).; Aadhaar card, ABC/APAAR ID and 6 passport-size photographs.. Check the applicable notice for originals, formats and category-specific certificates.

faqs.question: Which teaching facilities are documented at SU Pilani?

Horticulture, Polyhouse & Orchard Unit: Protected cultivation polyhouse/shade-net house, fruit orchard nursery and post-harvest handling practical space. faqs.question: How does admission to SU Pilani work?
faqs.answer: Admission to agriculture programmes at Shridhar University, Pilani is conducted through Rajasthan JET / Shridhar University Merit, alongside direct university merit counselling for eligible 10+2 Agriculture/Science candidates. Both Rajasthan JET state counselling seats and university-level seats require verification of Class XII subject combinations (PCB, PCM, PCA or Agriculture) and original academic certificates at reporting. Check Rajasthan JET or University Application Window: Register through the official Shridhar University, Pilani admissions portal (https://www.shridharuniversity.ac.in/department-of-agriculture/) or select the institution during Rajasthan JET / Pre-PG choice filling. Submit Academic & Entrance Score Details: Provide Class X and XII mark sheets (or B.Sc. Agriculture transcript for PG), JET/CUET/University entrance scorecard and category certificate. Document Verification & Tuition Fee Confirmation: Verify original documents on campus at Pilani and obtain the itemised semester/annual fee receipt including hostel and examination heads.

faqs.question: How does admission to SU Pilani work?
faqs.answer: Admission to agriculture programmes at Shridhar University, Pilani is conducted through Rajasthan JET / Shridhar University Merit, alongside direct university merit counselling for eligible 10+2 Agriculture/Science candidates. Both Rajasthan JET state counselling seats and university-level seats require verification of Class XII subject combinations (PCB, PCM, PCA or Agriculture) and original academic certificates at reporting. Check Rajasthan JET or University Application Window: Register through the official Shridhar University, Pilani admissions portal (https://www.shridharuniversity.ac.in/department-of-agriculture/) or select the institution during Rajasthan JET / Pre-PG choice filling. Submit Academic & Entrance Score Details: Provide Class X and XII mark sheets (or B.Sc. Agriculture transcript for PG), JET/CUET/University entrance scorecard and category certificate. Document Verification & Tuition Fee Confirmation: Verify original documents on campus at Pilani and obtain the itemised semester/annual fee receipt including hostel and examination heads.

faqs.question: What is the recorded ICAR scope for SU Pilani?
faqs.answer: Department of Agriculture, Shridhar University, Pilani: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture; M.Sc. Agriculture (Agronomy), recorded term 2022-23 to 2026-27 (UGC / State University Act & Rajasthan JET participating faculty; check ICAR NAEAB cohort notice). This entry applies to the named unit and programme.

faqs.question: What practical learning is described at SU Pilani?
faqs.answer: Rural Agricultural Work Experience (RAWE) in adopted villages during the final year. Experiential Learning Programme (ELP) modules in organic inputs, nursery management, Mushroom cultivation and seed production. Field visits to Krishi Vigyan Kendras (KVKs), state agricultural research stations and agri-input processing plants in Rajasthan.

faqs.question: Which teaching facilities are documented at SU Pilani?
faqs.answer: Agronomy & Instructional Crop Farm: Field demonstration plots at Pilani for kharif and rabi crop trials, seed bed preparation, weed management and micro-irrigation exercises. Soil Science & Agricultural Chemistry Lab: Equipped for soil pH, electrical conductivity, organic carbon, macronutrient (N-P-K) and micronutrient testing. Horticulture, Polyhouse & Orchard Unit: Protected cultivation polyhouse/shade-net house, fruit orchard nursery and post-harvest handling practical space. Plant Pathology, Entomology & Genetics Labs: Compound and stereo microscopy, insect rearing cages, disease specimen collection and seed purity testing equipment. Student Hostels, Library & Transport: Separate boys and girls residential hostels at Pilani, agricultural library journals, mess and city bus connectivity.

faqs.question: What student facilities are documented for SU Pilani?
faqs.answer: Student Hostels, Library & Transport: Separate boys and girls residential hostels at Pilani, agricultural library journals, mess and city bus connectivity.

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for SU Pilani?
faqs.answer: Shridhar University, Pilani offers merit-based tuition scholarships based on Class XII / qualifying examination marks or JET rank, alongside Rajasthan government post-matric scholarships (SJMS / Samaj Kalyan Vibhag) for eligible SC, ST, OBC, MBC and EBC students. University Entrance & Qualifying Marks Merit Scholarship (2026-27): Tuition fee waiver slabs (10% to 50% in first year) for applicants scoring 75%+ to 90%+ in 10+2 or high rank in Rajasthan JET / CUET; continuation requires maintaining minimum SGPA and 75% attendance. Rajasthan State Post-Matric & Girl Child Agriculture Incentive: Eligible Rajasthan domicile students can apply on the Rajasthan SSO Scholarship Portal; girl students in agriculture may also check state Rajshree / Agriculture Department incentive schemes.

faqs.question: What training and outcome evidence is available for SU Pilani?
faqs.answer: The placement and training cell at Shridhar University, Pilani coordinates final-year agribusiness agro-industrial attachments, KVK internships and preparation for Rajasthan Agriculture Supervisor, AAO, Pre-PG, ICAR JRF and IBPS AFO competitive examinations. Graduates pursue roles in seed, fertilizer, crop-protection, micro-irrigation, agri-fintech, warehousing and rural banking sectors, as well as M.Sc. Agriculture through Rajasthan Pre-PG and CUET-PG.

posts.title: How to compare agriculture fees, quotas and living costs
posts.description: Compare agriculture tuition by academic year, semester and quota, then add compulsory charges, deposits, hostel, mess and travel to your budget.
posts.summary: A low-looking fee may cover one semester, a particular quota or tuition alone. Compare the same period and applicant category, keep refundable deposits separate, and calculate both the amount needed at admission and the likely continuing cost.

sections.heading: Make every fee quote answer the same questions
paragraphs: Label each quote with the institution, campus, full degree, intake, applicant category, quota and payment period. Then identify what the amount includes. Tuition per semester, total annual academic fees and money payable on joining are three different measures. A four-year degree does not make a one-year quotation a guaranteed four-year price.

Use the official dated fee schedule and the offer applicable to your seat. Save both. If an adviser gives a rounded total, request the itemised calculation behind it. A useful comparison needs two totals: cash required before joining, including deposits and advances, and the recurring expense after one-time items are removed. You may need to fund a refundable deposit now even though it is not a permanent fee.

sections.heading: Read real examples without turning them into a price ranking
paragraphs: These published examples were checked for the stated periods. They illustrate different fee structures and are not comparable all-in residential prices. Follow the linked institution profile for the surrounding programme evidence and request your own applicable bill.

rows: ANGRAU affiliated-college academic total; hostel, transport and mess excluded
Same excluded residential/transport heads; college-specific amount
INR 5,000 one-time refundable caution deposit separately
INR 1,46,750 tuition per semester, Indian 2026–30 batch
INR 10,000 one-time admission fee; examination fee additional
Registration, admission, security and hostel separate

bullets: Use the [SBVR profile](/university/sbvr-agricultural-college) and [N.S. profile](/university/n-s-agricultural-college) for ANGRAU-affiliated examples.

Check [VIT Vellore](/university/vellore-institute-of-technology), [Karunya](/university/karunya-institute-of-technology-and-sciences) and [Raffles University](/university/raffles-university) for their separately defined charges.

sections.heading: Normalise the period and keep quota differences visible
paragraphs: For Karunya's published 2026–30 sheet, two listed semesters total INR 2,93,500 in tuition. Adding the stated one-time admission fee gives INR 3,03,500 for those first-year academic heads. That calculation still excludes examination and living costs. It is arithmetic from that particular sheet, not a new all-inclusive quotation.

ANGRAU's 2026–27 affiliated-college table also prints management-quota annual maximums: INR 1,70,000 for SBVR and INR 2,52,000 for N.S. Retain the word maximum. A ceiling is not proof of the amount offered to every student. Ask which quota is on your allotment and what charge applies to it; do not compare another student's convenor fee with your management offer.

At Raffles, the audited 2026–27 schedule separates INR 1,000 registration, INR 9,000 admission and INR 5,000 refundable academic security from the annual academic fee. Listing these heads separately makes the first payment clearer and prevents the security amount from being counted again each year.

sections.heading: Build a residential or day-scholar budget around your routine
paragraphs: Request hostel room type, billing period, availability, mess arrangement, electricity or other service charges, deposits and vacation rules. Confirm whether farm visits, rural work experience, industrial attachment or study tours create additional travel or accommodation costs. An available hostel facility is different from a confirmed room allocation.

Use your own quotations for the monthly budget. As an illustration only, a family allowance of INR 4,500 for ten months is INR 45,000; it is neither a college charge nor a claim about local living prices. Add home travel, books, clothing or field equipment, and a contingency suited to the family. Day scholars should include commuting time and cost, especially when practical work starts early or ends outside regular transport hours.

sections.heading: Treat scholarships, loans and refunds as separate decisions
paragraphs: Prepare the base budget before subtracting an unconfirmed scholarship. Ask for the scheme, eligible programme, award amount, covered fee heads, renewal conditions and when the benefit is credited. A tuition concession may leave hostel and mess fully payable. Read the [scholarship-conditions checklist](/blogs/agriculture-scholarship-conditions) before relying on a projected net amount.

For a loan, distinguish sanction, disbursement and the payment deadline: money approved in principle may not be available when a college requires it. Keep any financing decision separate from admission eligibility. Obtain the institution's applicable cancellation and refund terms, the responsible office and the process for claiming refundable deposits. This guide does not supply a universal refund entitlement or lending recommendation.

sections.heading: Ask for one written calculation before paying
paragraphs: Your final sheet should show each charge, whether it recurs, whether it is refundable, when it is due and whether it is confirmed or estimated. Total the first payment separately from the first academic year. For later years, identify which prices are published for the cohort and which remain assumptions. Avoid extending a current hostel quote across all years without labelling the estimate.

Send the sheet to the authorised admissions or accounts office and resolve missing heads before committing. Keep the offer, fee schedule, payment receipt and written scholarship decision together. Use the [fee-letter guide](/blogs/reading-an-agriculture-fee-letter) for another worked reading method. Compare affordability alongside the actual curriculum and practical arrangements, so the budget supports the course you intend to study.

faqs.question: Can I multiply the annual fee by four?
faqs.answer: You can use that as clearly labelled planning arithmetic, but it is not a verified course total unless the official cohort schedule fixes those fees for all four years. Add one-time, residential and other costs separately.

faqs.question: Is a management-quota maximum the payable fee?
faqs.answer: Not automatically. Confirm the actual approved charge and quota on your offer. A printed maximum is a ceiling, not evidence that every student pays that exact amount.

faqs.question: Should refundable deposits be excluded from my budget?
faqs.answer: Include them in cash needed at joining. Keep them separate from non-refundable fees and check the refund conditions and timing.

faqs.question: Do the figures above include hostel and mess?
faqs.answer: They are deliberately labelled academic or tuition examples. Do not treat them as complete residential costs; obtain the separate applicable schedules.

posts.summary: ANGRAU published dated manual counselling slots (2–10 November 2026) and a spot counselling notice (11 November 2026) for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture admissions across constituent and affiliated colleges.

sections.heading: What the ANGRAU November 2026 counselling notice records
paragraphs: Acharya N. G. Ranga Agricultural University (ANGRAU), Guntur recorded a phased manual counselling schedule on its 2026–27 undergraduate admission portal following Phase II college reporting on 23 October 2026. Special-category and AP AGRICET manual counselling was listed for 2 November 2026, followed by AP EAPCET rank-band manual counselling sessions on 3, 4, 6, 7, 9 and 10 November 2026, and spot counselling on 11 November 2026.
Each session applies only to registered candidates within the notified rank bands and subject to actual category-wise seat vacancies on the day of allotment.

sections.heading: How this affects ANGRAU-affiliated private agriculture colleges
paragraphs: Applicants considering [SBVR Agricultural College](/university/sbvr-agricultural-college), [N.S. Agricultural College](/university/n-s-agricultural-college), [Sri Krishnadevaraya College of Agricultural Sciences](/university/sri-krishnadevaraya-college-of-agricultural-sciences) and [Sri Kinjarapu Yerran Naidu College of Agricultural Sciences](/university/sri-kinjarapu-yerran-naidu-college-of-agricultural-sciences) should distinguish state convenor seats filled through ANGRAU manual/spot rounds from separate management-quota rules.

Read our [ANGRAU private agriculture college admission guide](/articles/angrau-private-agriculture-college-admission) and [counselling preparation checklist](/blogs/prepare-for-agriculture-counselling) before travelling for manual verification.

sections.heading: Documents and fee demand checks for manual counselling
paragraphs: Manual and spot counselling rounds typically require immediate production of original Class 10 and Intermediate marksheets, AP EAPCET rank card, residence/caste certificates, and readiness to pay the prescribed semester charge upon seat allotment. Confirm the exact fee category (convenor vs management) using [the agriculture fee budget guide](/articles/agriculture-fee-budget).

faqs.question: Does a manual counselling notice guarantee seat availability in every affiliated college?
faqs.answer: No. Manual and spot counselling depend on real-time vacancies remaining after earlier online phases. Check the live vacancy matrix published by ANGRAU.

faqs.question: Are convenor-quota and management-quota fees identical at ANGRAU-affiliated colleges?
faqs.answer: No. Convenor and management quotas have distinct fee structures approved under state and university norms. Confirm the exact quota on your allotment letter.
